features.name: Spellcasting

Prepared spells grow from 3 at Monk 3 to 13 at Monk 20, with slots up to level 4 (level 4 at Monk 19). Swap one prepared spell per Monk level. Counts one third of Monk levels for multiclass slots.

features.name: Mystic Focus

features.name: Focused Strike

features.name: Improved Mystic Fighting Style

It Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action, or give up one of your attacks, to have it act. Vestige's Strike: spell-attack, 5 feet or 60 feet, 1d6 + 3 + Charisma modifier damage of its type. Divine Power once per day: Undead curse (Disadvantage attacking you and it), Fiend place-swap within 60 feet, or Celestial heal 2d8 + Charisma modifier and end Blinded, Deafened, or Poisoned. Re-manifest with a 1-minute ceremony; reshape it on a Long Rest.

features.name: Vestige Spells

features.name: Vestige Power

features.description: Reaction when the vestige would drop to 0 HP: spend a Pact Magic slot to restore it to full HP and teleport it 30 feet. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Semblance of Life
features.description: Magic action, vestige within 90 feet: for 1 hour it becomes a Celestial, Fiendish, or Undead Spirit from the matching Summon spell at half your Warlock level (max 9), keeping its personality, Divine Power, HP, and Hit Dice, plus Temporary Hit Points equal to the spirit's HP. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.description: Bonus Action: teleport 30 feet, or swap places with a willing Medium or smaller creature in range. Uses equal to Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.description: Add two Conjuration spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, plus one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

features.name: Distant Transposition
features.description: Benign Transposition reaches 60 feet, and a level 3+ slot restores one use.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.description: Creatures you summon or create with a slot-cast Conjuration spell arrive with Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wizard level, and resist all damage except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant while those last.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.description: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Conjuration spells.

features.name: Splintered Summons
features.description: When a slot-cast spell summons a spirit with its own stat block (Summon Aberration and the like), summon two at half HP each. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5+ slot.

features.name: Enchanting Conversationalist
features.description: Gain Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion proficiency and add your Intelligence modifier (min +1) to checks with it.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.description: Add two Enchantment spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, plus one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

features.name: Hypnotic Presence
features.description: Magic action, creature within 10 feet that can see or hear you: Wisdom save or Charmed, Incapacitated, and Speed 0 for up to 1 minute (ends if it moves beyond 10 feet, loses sight and sound of you, or takes damage). Uses equal to Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.description: When slot-casting an Enchantment spell that adds targets at higher levels, treat it as one level higher. Uses equal to Intelligence modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet hits you: Wisdom save or the attack misses and is redirected, with the same roll, to another creature in range of your choice. Once per Long Rest; recharges when you slot-cast an Enchantment spell.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.description: One creature you Charm with a slot-cast Enchantment spell doesn't know it was Charmed. Once during the spell, a Magic action forces an Intelligence save; on a failure it loses up to 1 + Intelligence modifier hours of memory, within the spell's duration.

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.description: Add two Necromancy spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, plus one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

features.name: Necromancy Spellbook
features.description: Resistance to Necrotic damage. Find Familiar enters your spellbook with Skeleton or Zombie forms (or any form as Undead), and you can give up an attack for the familiar to attack with its Reaction. Undead Vitality: a slot-cast Necromancy spell heals an Undead within 60 feet for the slot level + your Wizard level.

features.name: Grave Power
features.description: While holding your spellbook: Arcane Recovery also removes 1 Exhaustion level, and your Wizard spells and features ignore Necrotic Resistance.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.description: Animate Dead is always prepared, castable free once per Long Rest, and always cast one level higher. While holding your spellbook, undead you create or summon gain extra HP equal to Intelligence modifier + half your Wizard level, and your undead within 60 feet add your Intelligence modifier (min 1) in Necrotic damage to their hits.

features.name: Harvest Undead
features.description: Reaction when damage leaves you Bloodied but above 0 HP: drop one of your visible undead to 0 HP and regain HP equal to your Wizard level.

features.name: Death's Master
features.description: While holding your spellbook. Bolster Undead: once per Long Rest, a Bonus Action gives your necromancy-made undead within 60 feet Temporary Hit Points equal to your Wizard level. Extinguish Undead: an undead you see dropping to 0 HP explodes in a 10-foot Emanation (d6s equal to half its remaining Hit Dice, Dexterity save for half, no Reactions on a failure); one you don't control costs a Reaction and a level 5+ slot.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.description: Add two Transmutation spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, plus one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.description: On a Long Rest, make a stone (also a Spellcasting Focus). Its bearer gains Constitution save proficiency plus one of: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60), Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, or +10 Speed. Change the benefit when you slot-cast a Transmutation spell.

features.name: Wondrous Alteration
features.description: Alter Self is always prepared and castable free once per Long Rest, with bonuses: Dash as a Bonus Action underwater, Advantage on Deception checks while disguised, or 2d6 natural weapons plus Advantage on Concentration saves.

features.name: Empowered Transmutation
features.description: Slot-cast Transmutation spells that make no attack roll and force no save count as one level higher. Uses equal to Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Potent Stone
features.description: Your stone carries two benefits (Resistance can be taken twice for different types), and adds Mighty Build (Advantage on Strength saves, carry as one size larger) and Tremorsense 30 feet to the options.

features.name: Shape-Shifter
features.description: Polymorph is always prepared and castable free once per Long Rest. Once per Long Rest, polymorphing yourself lets you keep your mind, mental scores, proficiencies, class features, and feats, and cast Transmutation spells without costly or consumed materials.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.description: Magic action: spend the stone's power (a level 7+ slot keeps it intact). Major Transformation (10 minutes to turn a nonmagical object up to a 10-foot Cube into another of similar size and equal or lesser value), Panacea (heal half max HP, cure magical contagions and curses, end Poisoned and Petrified), Restore Life (free Raise Dead), or Restore Youth (Exhaustion to 0, 3d10 years younger).

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as Rituals only, using Wisdom.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.description: Each time you Rage pick one: Bear (Resistance to all damage but Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant), Eagle (Disengage and Dash as part of the Rage Bonus Action, and as a Bonus Action while raging), or Wolf (allies have Advantage on attacks against enemies within 5 feet of you).

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.description: Pick one, changeable after a Long Rest: Owl (Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 if you have it), Panther (Climb Speed equal to Speed), or Salmon (Swim Speed equal to Speed).

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.description: Cast Commune with Nature as a Ritual only, using Wisdom.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.description: Each time you Rage pick one: Falcon (Fly Speed equal to Speed while unarmored), Lion (enemies within 5 feet have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you), or Ram (melee hits can knock a Large or smaller creature Prone).

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
features.description: Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level when you Rage. While raging, at the start of each turn give another creature within 10 feet Temporary Hit Points equal to a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus; they vanish when the Rage ends.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: Reaction while raging when a creature starts its turn within 30 feet: Strength save (DC 8 + Strength mod + Proficiency Bonus) or it is teleported next to you, and you can drop its Speed to 0 for the turn.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.description: On your turn, +10 feet reach with Heavy or Versatile melee weapons, and a hit can also apply Push or Topple alongside the weapon's other mastery.

features.name: Travel along the Tree
features.description: Teleport up to 60 feet when you Rage and as a Bonus Action while raging. Once per Rage, make it 150 feet and bring up to six willing creatures within 10 feet.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.description: Without armor or a Shield: Advantage on dance Performance checks, AC 10 + DEX + CHA, an Unarmed Strike whenever you spend Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, Bonus Action or Reaction, and Unarmed Strikes that use DEX and deal your Bardic Inspiration die + DEX Bludgeoning.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.description: Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet: spend Bardic Inspiration to move half your Speed, and an ally within 30 feet can use its Reaction to do the same, without Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.description: When you roll Initiative, spend Bardic Inspiration: you and allies within 30 feet add the die roll to Initiative.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.description: Dexterity saves for half damage: none on a success, half on a failure, and creatures within 5 feet making the same save share it.

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter, Thunderwave (3); Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing (5); Control Water, Ice Storm (7); Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster (9).

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.description: Bonus Action, spend Wild Shape: a 5-foot Emanation for 10 minutes. On creation and as a Bonus Action, a creature in it makes a Constitution save or takes WIS mod d6 Cold and, if Large or smaller, is pushed 15 feet.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.description: The Emanation grows to 10 feet, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: While Wrath of the Sea is active: Fly Speed equal to your Speed and Resistance to Cold, Lightning and Thunder.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.description: Place the Emanation on a willing creature within 60 feet instead, or on both of you for two Wild Shape uses.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: A Tiny star chart that is a Spellcasting Focus. While holding it, Guidance and Guiding Bolt are prepared and Guiding Bolt can be cast without a slot WIS mod times per Long Rest.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: Bonus Action, spend Wild Shape: a glowing form for 10 minutes with one constellation. Archer: Bonus Action ranged spell attack for 1d8 + WIS Radiant. Chalice: healing spells also heal a creature within 30 feet for 1d8 + WIS. Dragon: treat 9 or lower as 10 on INT and WIS checks and Concentration saves.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: After a Long Rest roll a die: even lets you add 1d6 to a D20 Test within 30 feet, odd lets you subtract 1d6, as a Reaction. WIS mod uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: Archer and Chalice become 2d8, Dragon grants Fly 20 feet with hover, and you can switch constellation at the start of each turn.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: In Starry Form, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.description: Once per turn on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 1 Focus Point for an extra Martial Arts die + WIS mod Necrotic.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.description: Magic action, 1 Focus Point: touch heals a Martial Arts die + WIS mod. One Flurry of Blows strike can be replaced by a free Hand of Healing.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.description: Proficiency in Insight and Medicine and with the Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.description: Hand of Harm can also Poison until the end of your next turn; Hand of Healing can also end Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.description: With Flurry of Blows, replace each strike with a free Hand of Healing, and apply Hand of Harm free on a Flurry hit (still once per turn). WIS mod uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.description: Magic action, 5 Focus Points: return a creature dead under 24 hours to life with 4d10 + WIS mod Hit Points, clearing those five conditions. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: Spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness without components, seeing through it and moving it within 60 feet each turn. Darkvision 60 feet (or +60). Minor Illusion with Wisdom.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: In Dim Light or Darkness, Bonus Action teleport 60 feet to another such space, with Advantage on your next melee attack this turn.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
features.description: Spend 1 Focus Point to ignore the light requirement, and make an Unarmed Strike right after teleporting.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: Magic action in dim light or darkness, 3 Focus Points: for 1 minute you are Invisible, move through occupied spaces, and use Flurry of Blows for free.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: At the start of your turn spend 1 Focus Point for 10 minutes of: Unarmed Strike reach +10 feet, and hits can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder with a Strength save to move the target 10 feet.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
features.description: Elementalism cantrip, cast with Wisdom.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.description: Magic action, 2 Focus Points: 20-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet, Dexterity save for three Martial Arts dice of a chosen element, half on a success.

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.description: While attuned, Fly and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
features.description: While attuned: Resistance to a chosen element (changeable each turn), Step of the Wind adds 20 feet and deals a Martial Arts die to creatures you pass, and once per turn an Unarmed Strike adds a Martial Arts die.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Sliver (3); Hunger of Hadar, Sending (5); Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration (7); Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis (9).

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: Bonus Action: telepathy with a creature within 30 feet, at a range of CHA mod miles, for minutes equal to your Sorcerer level.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: Cast a level 1+ Psionic Spell by spending Sorcery Points equal to its level instead of a slot, with no Verbal, Somatic or non-costly Material components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.description: Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage against Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.description: Bonus Action, 1+ Sorcery Points for 10 minutes, one benefit per point: Swim at twice Speed and breathe water, Fly at Speed with hover, see Invisible creatures within 60 feet, or squeeze through 1-inch gaps and slip restraints.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.description: Magic action: teleport up to 120 feet; creatures within 30 feet of where you left make a Strength save or take 3d10 Force and are pulled toward that space (half damage on a success). Once per Long Rest, or restore it with 5 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Clockwork Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good (3); Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy (5); Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct (7); Greater Restoration, Wall of Force (9). Plus a cosmetic manifestation of order.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: Reaction: cancel Advantage and Disadvantage on a d20 roll by a creature within 60 feet. CHA mod uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.description: Magic action, 1 to 5 Sorcery Points: a ward of that many d8s on you or a creature within 30 feet, spent to reduce damage, lasting until your next Long Rest.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.description: Bonus Action for 1 minute: attacks against you cannot have Advantage, and treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with 5 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.description: Magic action: a 30-foot Cube heals up to 100 Hit Points split as you like, repairs objects, and ends spells of level 6 or lower on chosen targets. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with 7 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, roll a d20; on a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Give yourself Advantage on one D20 Test. Recharges when you cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot (which triggers a surge roll) or finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Reaction, 1 Sorcery Point: add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's d20 roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: Roll twice on the Wild Magic Surge table and pick either.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.description: After casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, choose any surge effect but the last row instead of rolling. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Archfey Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Calm Emotions, Faerie Fire, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force, Sleep (3); Blink, Plant Growth (5); Dominate Beast, Greater Invisibility (7); Dominate Person, Seeming (9).

features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.description: Misty Step without a slot CHA mod times per Long Rest, adding Refreshing Step (you or a creature within 10 feet gains 1d10 Temporary Hit Points) or Taunting Step (creatures within 5 feet of where you left make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you).

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: Cast Misty Step as a Reaction to taking damage, and add Disappearing Step (Invisible until your next turn or until you attack, deal damage or cast) and Dreadful Step (Wisdom save or 2d10 Psychic near either space).

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: Immune to Charmed. Reaction when hit: halve the damage and the attacker makes a Wisdom save or takes the same Psychic damage. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a Pact Magic slot.

features.name: Bewitching Magic
features.description: After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with an action and a slot, cast Misty Step free as part of that action.

features.name: Celestial Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light, Sacred Flame (3); Daylight, Revivify (5); Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire (7); Greater Restoration, Summon Celestial (9).

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: A pool of d6s equal to 1 + Warlock level; Bonus Action, spend up to CHA mod dice to heal you or a creature within 60 feet. Refills on a Long Rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Resistance to Radiant damage, and once per turn add CHA mod to one target of a Radiant or Fire spell.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: On Magical Cunning or a Short or Long Rest, gain Temporary Hit Points of Warlock level + CHA mod, and up to five creatures gain half your level + CHA mod.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: When you or an ally within 60 feet is about to make a Death Saving Throw, it regains half its Hit Point maximum and can stand, and chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d8 + CHA mod Radiant and are Blinded this turn. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: Bonus Action: telepathy with a creature within 30 feet, at a range of CHA mod miles, for minutes equal to your Warlock level.

features.name: Great Old One Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Phantasmal Force, Tasha's Hideous Laughter (3); Clairvoyance, Hunger of Hadar (5); Confusion, Summon Aberration (7); Modify Memory, Telekinesis (9).

features.name: Psychic Spells
features.description: Warlock damage spells can deal Psychic instead, and Warlock Enchantment and Illusion spells need no Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.description: When you link with Awakened Mind, the creature makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage attacking you while you have Advantage attacking it for the link's duration. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it with a Pact Magic slot.

features.name: Eldritch Hex
features.description: Hex always prepared, and its target also has Disadvantage on saves of the chosen ability.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Your thoughts cannot be read without consent, Resistance to Psychic damage, and creatures that deal Psychic damage to you take the same amount.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: Summon Aberration can skip Concentration for a 1-minute duration, gains Temporary Hit Points of Warlock level + CHA mod, and adds your Hex bonus to its first hit each turn on the hexed target.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Add two Abjuration Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot creates a ward (once per Long Rest) with Hit Points of twice your Wizard level + INT mod that absorbs damage to you. Abjuration spells restore twice the slot level; a Bonus Action and a slot does the same.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: Reaction: your Arcane Ward absorbs damage to a creature within 30 feet.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.description: Counterspell and Dispel Magic always prepared; Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action adding your Proficiency Bonus; a failed attempt keeps the slot.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: Advantage on saves against spells and Resistance to spell damage.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Add two Divination Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

features.name: Portent
features.description: After each Long Rest roll two d20s; before any D20 Test by you or a creature you can see, replace the roll with one of them, once per turn.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: Casting a Divination spell with a level 2+ slot restores one lower-level expended slot (level 5 or lower).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description: Bonus Action until your next rest, once per Short or Long Rest: Darkvision 120 feet, read any language, or cast See Invisibility without a slot.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: Roll three d20s for Portent.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: Add two Illusion Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

features.name: Improved Illusions
features.description: Illusion spells need no Verbal components and gain 60 feet of range if they reach 10+ feet. Learn Minor Illusion (or another Wizard cantrip) free; it makes sound and image together and can be cast as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.description: Summon Beast and Summon Fey always prepared; cast either as Illusion, once each per Long Rest without a slot at half Hit Points.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: Reaction when hit by an attack: it misses. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it with a level 2+ slot.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: Bonus Action while an Illusion spell cast with a slot lasts: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute; it cannot deal damage or conditions.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies and the Herbalism Kit (another Artisan's Tools for each you already have); crafting potions takes half the time.

features.name: Alchemist Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Healing Word, Ray of Sickness (3); Flaming Sphere, Melf's Acid Arrow (5); Gaseous Form, Mass Healing Word (9); Death Ward, Vitriolic Sphere (13); Cloudkill, Raise Dead (17).

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.description: After a Long Rest with Alchemist's Supplies, make two random elixirs (three at level 5, four at 9, five at 15) that vanish at your next Long Rest; drinking or giving one is a Bonus Action. Magic action and a spell slot: make one more, choosing its effect.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: Spells cast through Alchemist's Supplies add INT mod (min +1) to one healing roll or one Acid, Fire or Poison damage roll.

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.description: Cast Lesser Restoration through Alchemist's Supplies without a slot or preparing it, INT mod times per Long Rest.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.description: Once per turn add 2d8 Force to an Artificer spell's Acid, Fire or Poison damage; Resistance to Acid and Poison and immunity to Poisoned; Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron through Alchemist's Supplies without slot, preparation or Material components once per Long Rest.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Heavy armor training and proficiency with Smith's Tools (or another Artisan's Tools); crafting armor takes half the time.

features.name: Armorer Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Magic Missile, Thunderwave (3); Mirror Image, Shatter (5); Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt (9); Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility (13); Passwall, Wall of Force (17).

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.description: Magic action with Smith's Tools: the armor you wear becomes Arcane Armor, with no Strength requirement, don and doff as a Utilize action, cannot be removed against your will, and works as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Armor Model
features.description: Choose a model, changeable on a Short or Long Rest; its weapon uses INT for attack and damage. Dreadnaught: Force Demolisher (Reach, 1d10 Force, push or pull a smaller creature 10 feet) and Giant Stature (Bonus Action: Large and +5 feet reach for 1 minute, INT mod uses per Long Rest). Guardian: Thunder Pulse (1d8 Thunder; the target has Disadvantage attacking others) and Defensive Field (Bonus Action while Bloodied: Temporary Hit Points equal to Artificer level). Infiltrator: Lightning Launcher (ranged 90/300, 1d6 Lightning, +1d6 once per turn), Powered Steps (+5 feet Speed), and Advantage on Stealth.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice with the Attack action.

features.name: Improved Armorer
features.description: Learn an extra Armor plan and create one extra Armor item with Replicate Magic Item, and +1 to attack and damage with your model weapon.

features.name: Perfected Armor
features.description: Dreadnaught: 2d6 demolisher, Giant Stature reaches 10 feet and Large or Huge with Advantage on Strength checks and saves. Guardian: 1d10 pulse and a Reaction pull of 25 feet toward you with a melee attack if adjacent (INT mod uses per Long Rest). Infiltrator: 2d6 launcher whose targets glow and have Disadvantage attacking you, and a Bonus Action Fly Speed of twice your Speed this turn (INT mod uses per Long Rest).

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Proficiency with Martial Ranged weapons and Woodcarver's Tools (or another Artisan's Tools); crafting wands takes half the time.

features.name: Artillerist Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Shield, Thunderwave (3); Scorching Ray, Shatter (5); Fireball, Wind Wall (9); Ice Storm, Wall of Fire (13); Cone of Cold, Wall of Force (17).

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.description: Magic action with Smith's or Woodcarver's Tools: a Small or Tiny cannon (AC 18, Hit Points 5 per Artificer level) for 1 hour, once per Long Rest or by spending a slot. Bonus Action within 60 feet: move it 15 feet and fire Flamethrower (15-foot Cone, Dexterity save, 2d8 Fire), Force Ballista (ranged spell attack within 120 feet, 2d8 Force and push 5 feet), or Protector (it and chosen creatures within 10 feet gain 1d8 + INT mod Temporary Hit Points).

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.description: After a Long Rest, carve a Rod, Staff, Wand or Martial Ranged weapon into an Arcane Firearm; spells cast through it add 1d8 to one damage roll.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.description: Cannon damage and Protector gain +1d8, and a Reaction when it is damaged detonates it: 20-foot Dexterity save for 3d10 Force, half on a success.

features.name: Fortified Position
features.description: Keep two cannons, created and commanded together, and you and allies within 10 feet of a cannon have Half Cover.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Proficiency with Smith's Tools (or another Artisan's Tools); crafting weapons takes half the time.

features.name: Battle Smith Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Heroism, Shield (3); Shining Smite, Warding Bond (5); Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage (9); Aura of Purity, Fire Shield (13); Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds (17).

features.name: Battle Ready
features.description: Use INT for attack and damage with magic weapons, proficiency with Martial weapons, and proficient weapons work as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.description: A Medium construct companion (AC 12 + INT mod, Hit Points 5 + 5 per Artificer level, Speed 40) that acts on your turn and Dodges unless you command it with a Bonus Action. Force-Empowered Rend: 1d8 + 2 + INT mod Force. Repair three times a day, and Deflect Attack as a Reaction. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a slot; rebuild it after a Long Rest with Smith's Tools.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice with the Attack action; one attack can instead command the Steel Defender to Rend.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.description: Once per turn when your magic weapon or Steel Defender hits: an extra 2d6 Force, or heal a creature within 30 feet of the target 2d6. INT mod uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.description: Arcane Jolt becomes 4d6, and Deflect Attack deals 1d4 + INT mod Force to the attacker.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies and Cartographer's Tools (another Artisan's Tools for each you already have); scribing Spell Scrolls takes half the time.

features.name: Cartographer Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Faerie Fire, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word (3); Locate Object, Mind Spike (5); Call Lightning, Clairvoyance (9); Banishment, Locate Creature (13); Scrying, Teleportation Circle (17).

features.name: Adventurer's Atlas
features.description: After a Long Rest with Cartographer's Tools, give magic maps to 2 to 1 + INT mod creatures (you can be one). Holders add 1d4 to Initiative, know each other's locations on the plane, and can target each other without sight within range.

features.name: Mapping Magic
features.description: Faerie Fire without a slot INT mod times per Long Rest. Portal Jump: spend half your Speed to teleport 10 feet, or next to a map holder within 30 feet.

features.name: Guided Precision
features.description: Once per turn add INT mod to one damage roll of a Cartographer spell or an attack against a creature under your Faerie Fire, and damage cannot break your Concentration on Faerie Fire.

features.name: Ingenious Movement
features.description: When you use Flash of Genius, you or a willing creature within 30 feet can also teleport 30 feet.

features.name: Superior Atlas
features.description: Safe Haven: a map holder dropping to 0 Hit Points can destroy its map to instead have twice your Artificer level in Hit Points and teleport next to a holder. Unerring Path: cast Find the Path free once per Long Rest while holding a map.

features.name: Moon's Inspiration
features.description: Inspired Eclipse: when you give Bardic Inspiration as a Bonus Action, you can also turn Invisible and teleport up to 30 feet (invisible until your next turn starts or you attack, deal damage or cast). Lunar Vitality: once per turn when a spell of yours heals a creature, expend a Bardic Inspiration die to add its roll to the healing, and the creature gains +10 feet Speed until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Primal Lore
features.description: Learn Druidic and one Druid cantrip (a Bard spell for you, not counted against cantrips known; swappable on each Bard level). Gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception or Survival.

features.name: Blessing of Moonlight
features.description: Moonbeam is always prepared. Once per Long Rest, cast it glowing (Dim Light 5 feet): whenever a creature fails its save against that Moonbeam, another creature you see within 60 feet regains 2d4 HP.

features.name: Eventide's Splendor
features.description: Shadow of the New Moon: the creature receiving your Inspired Eclipse die can also turn Invisible and use its Reaction to teleport 30 feet. Vibrance of the Full Moon: Lunar Vitality can use a d6 roll instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.

features.name: Knightly Envoy
features.description: Cast Comprehend Languages as a Ritual (Cha). Learn a language, swappable after a Long Rest for one you met in the last 24 hours. Proficiency in Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion or Performance.

features.name: Group Recovery
features.description: When Second Wind heals you, up to Cha mod allies (min 1) in a 30-foot Emanation regain 1d4 + Fighter level HP. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Team Tactics
features.description: Allies healed by Group Recovery have Advantage on D20 Tests until your next turn starts.

features.name: Rallying Surge
features.description: When you Action Surge, up to Cha mod allies (min 1) in a 30-foot Emanation can each use a Reaction to attack once or move half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Shared Resilience
features.description: Reaction when an ally you see within 60 feet fails a save: expend Indomitable to let it reroll with a bonus equal to your Fighter level.

features.name: Inspiring Commander
features.description: Group Recovery and Rallying Surge reach 60 feet. Immunity to Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Elemental Smite
features.description: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend Channel Divinity for one effect: Dao's Crush (target Grappled and Restrained, escape DC = spell DC); Djinni's Escape (teleport 30 feet and turn semi-incorporeal until your next turn ends: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, immune to Grappled, Prone, Restrained); Efreeti's Fury (target takes 2d4 Fire, then a second creature within 30 feet takes 2d4 Fire); Marid's Surge (target and chosen creatures in a 10-foot Emanation make a Str save or are pushed 15 feet and knocked Prone).

features.name: Genie Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Chromatic Orb, Elementalism, Thunderous Smite (3); Mirror Image, Phantasmal Force (5); Fly, Gaseous Form (9); Conjure Minor Elementals, Summon Elemental (13); Banishing Smite, Contact Other Plane (17).

features.name: Genie's Splendor
features.description: Unarmored, AC = 10 + Dex + Cha (Shield allowed). Proficiency in Acrobatics, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Aura of Elemental Shielding
features.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection resist one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder, changeable at the start of each turn.

features.name: Elemental Rebuke
features.description: Reaction when hit by an attack roll: halve the damage, and the attacker makes a Dex save against your spell DC, taking 2d10 + Cha mod of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (half on success). Cha mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Noble Scion
features.description: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Fly Speed 60 feet (hover), and a Reaction to turn a failed D20 Test by you or an ally in your aura into a success. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 5 slot.

features.name: Frigid Explorer
features.description: Your weapon attacks, Ranger spells and features ignore Cold resistance; you resist Cold. Once per turn a weapon hit can deal an extra 1d4 Cold (1d6 at Ranger 11).

features.name: Hunter's Rime
features.description: Casting Hunter's Mark grants 1d10 + Ranger level Temporary HP; a marked creature can't Disengage.

features.name: Winter Walker Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Ice Knife (3), Hold Person (5), Remove Curse (9), Ice Storm (13), Cone of Cold (17).

features.name: Fortifying Soul
features.description: Magic action, once per Long Rest: up to Wis mod creatures you see (min 1) regain 1d10 + Ranger level HP and have Advantage on saves against Frightened for 1 hour.

features.name: Chilling Retribution
features.description: Reaction when hit by an attack roll: the attacker makes a Wis save against your spell DC or is Stunned with Speed 0 until the end of your next turn. Wis mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Frozen Haunt
features.description: When you cast Hunter's Mark, take a ghostly snow form for its duration: immunity to Cold, chosen creatures in a 15-foot Emanation take 2d4 Cold when it starts and at the start of each of your turns; immunity to Grappled, Prone, Restrained, and you move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside one). Once per Long Rest, or a level 4+ slot.

features.name: Bloodthirst
features.description: Reaction when an enemy you see within 30 feet becomes Bloodied without dying: teleport within 5 feet of it and make one melee attack. Int mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Dread Allegiance
features.description: Choose a Dead Three god (changeable after a Long Rest): Bane (Psychic resistance, Minor Illusion), Bhaal (Poison resistance, Blade Ward) or Myrkul (Necrotic resistance, Chill Touch); Int is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Strike Fear
features.description: New Cunning Strike, Terrify (cost 1d6): Wis save or Frightened for 1 minute, with you having Advantage on attacks against it (repeats the save each turn end).

features.name: Aura of Malevolence
features.description: When you teleport with Bloodthirst, chosen creatures within 10 feet of your start or end space take damage equal to your Int mod, of your Dread Allegiance type, ignoring resistance.

features.name: Dread Incarnate
features.description: Regain one Bloodthirst use on a Short Rest. Treat 1s and 2s on Sneak Attack dice as 3s.

features.name: Spellfire Burst
features.description: Once per turn, when you spend Sorcery Points as part of a Magic action or Bonus Action: Bolstering Flames (you or a creature within 30 feet gains 1d4 + Cha mod Temporary HP) or Radiant Fire (a creature within 30 feet takes 1d4 Fire or Radiant).

features.name: Spellfire Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Scorching Ray (3); Aura of Vitality, Dispel Magic (5); Fire Shield, Wall of Fire (7); Greater Restoration, Flame Strike (9).

features.name: Absorb Spells
features.description: Counterspell is always prepared; when a target fails its save against your Counterspell, regain 1d4 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Honed Spellfire
features.description: Bolstering Flames adds your Sorcerer level; Radiant Fire deals 1d8.

features.name: Crown of Spellfire
features.description: When you use Innate Sorcery, empower it: once per turn when hit, spend up to Cha mod Hit Point Dice to reduce the damage by the roll; Fly Speed 60 feet (hover); Evasion-style protection on half-damage saves unless Incapacitated. Once per Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Bladesong
features.description: Bonus Action, unarmored and without a Shield, 1 minute: +Int mod AC (min +1), +10 feet Speed, Advantage on Acrobatics; use Int for proficient weapon attacks and damage; add Int mod to Concentration saves. Ends if Incapacitated, you don armor or a Shield, or you attack two-handed. Int mod uses per Long Rest (min 1); regain one with Arcane Recovery.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.description: Proficiency with Melee Martial weapons lacking Two-Handed and Heavy; use a proficient Melee weapon as a Spellcasting Focus. Proficiency in Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice with the Attack action; one attack can be replaced by an action-cost Wizard cantrip.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.description: Reaction when damaged during Bladesong: expend a spell slot to reduce the damage by five times its level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.description: After casting an action-time spell, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Reanimator Spells
features.description: Always prepared: False Life, Spare the Dying, Witch Bolt (3); Blindness/Deafness, Enhance Ability (5); Animate Dead, Lightning Bolt (9); Blight, Death Ward (13); Antilife Shell, Raise Dead (17).

features.name: Reanimator's Skill Set
features.description: Jolt to Life: Int mod times per Long Rest, a Spare the Dying you cast also restores HP equal to your Artificer level, and chosen creatures in a 10-foot Emanation from the target make a Dex save or take 2d4 Lightning (half on success; 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17). Reanimator's Tools: proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies (or another Artisan's Tools).

features.name: Reanimated Companion
features.description: Magic action with Artisan's Tools: create a Medium Undead companion (AC 10 + Int, HP 5 + 5 x Artificer level, Speed 30, resists Necrotic and Poison, immune to Lightning, Charmed, Exhaustion, Poisoned, Blindsight 60). Death Burst on death: 10-foot Emanation, Dex save vs your DC, 2d4 Necrotic (half on success). Lightning Absorption heals it. Dreadful Swipe: spell attack, 1d4 + Int Necrotic and no Opportunity Attacks for the target. Lasts until a Long Rest; once per Long Rest or by expending a slot. Acts on your turn, Dodging unless you command it with a Bonus Action.

features.name: Strange Modifications
features.description: Each companion gets one option: Arcane Conduit (cast spells from its space; once per turn add Int to an Evocation or Necromancy Artificer spell's damage roll) or Ferocity (Dreadful Swipe die becomes 1d6).

features.name: Improved Reanimation
features.description: Death Burst deals 4d4, and the companion's Necrotic damage ignores Resistance.

features.name: Macabre Modifications
features.description: Two modification options, adding Bloated (Large, Swipe pushes 10 feet, Int added to Death Burst), Gaunt (Speed 45, spider climb, chosen creatures starting within 10 feet make a Wis save or are Frightened) and Moist (swim speed, squeezes through 1 inch, attackers within 10 feet take Int mod Acid).

features.name: Refined Reanimation
features.description: Facilitated Revival: cast Raise Dead once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components using your tools. Life Transfer: Reaction when you or the companion takes damage, gain HP equal to its current HP and it dies (Death Burst). Superior Modifications: three modification options.

features.name: Hollow Warden Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Wrathful Smite (3), Alter Self (5), Phantom Steed (9), Dominate Beast (13), Steel Wind Strike (17).

features.name: Wrath of the Wild
features.description: Bonus Action and a Favored Enemy use: ghastly form for 1 minute. Ancient Armor: +1 AC (+2 at 11). Prowling Retribution: Opportunity Attack against a creature within 5 feet right after it damages you or an ally. Unnerving Aura: on transforming and at the start of your turns, chosen creatures in a 10-foot Emanation make a Wis save or are Frightened until your next turn.

features.name: Hungering Might
features.description: Add Wis mod (min +1) to Con saves. While transformed and Bloodied, once per turn a hit restores 1d10 + Wis mod HP.

features.name: Rot and Violence
features.description: While transformed: creatures failing the Unnerving Aura save can't regain HP or take Reactions until your next turn, and weapon hits can add the Sap or Slow mastery alongside another mastery.

features.name: Ancient Might
features.description: Hits on Frightened creatures add Wis mod damage. Persistent Wrath: when dropped to 0 HP while transformed, go to twice your Ranger level instead (once per Long Rest or a level 4+ slot). Immunity to Exhaustion.

features.name: Shadow Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds, Pass Without Trace (3); Hunger of Hadar, Nondetection (5); Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer (7); Contagion, Creation (9).

features.name: Power of Shadow
features.description: Darkvision 120 and Blindsight 10; you see through your own spells' Darkness. Strength of the Grave: once per Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP, a Cha save (DC 5 + damage) leaves you at Cha mod + Sorcerer level HP.

features.name: Beasts of Ill Omen
features.description: Spend 3 Sorcery Points to cast Summon Beast as a Bonus Action without a slot or Material components; enemies within 5 feet of it have Disadvantage on saves against your spells. Optionally no Concentration (1 minute, ends if recast).

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.description: In Dim Light or Darkness, Bonus Action teleport 120 feet to another dim or dark space you see.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.description: With Innate Sorcery, take a shadow form: move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside) and resist all damage but Force and Radiant. Once per Long Rest, or 6 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Form of Dread
features.description: Bonus Action, 1 minute, Cha mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest: gain 1d10 + Warlock level temp HP, immunity to Frightened, and once per turn a hit forces a Wis save or Frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Undead Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Bane, Blindness/Deafness, Phantasmal Force, Ray of Sickness (3); Speak with Dead, Summon Undead (5); Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer (7); Antilife Shell, Cloudkill (9).

features.name: Grave Touched
features.description: Your Necrotic damage ignores Necrotic resistance, and once per turn a damaging spell can switch to Necrotic. In Form of Dread, once per turn roll one extra damage die on a Necrotic hit. No need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep for Exhaustion purposes; magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.description: Resistance to Necrotic (immunity in Form of Dread). Once per Short or Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP, chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Con save for 2d10 + Cha Necrotic (half on success); you return to twice your Warlock level HP and gain 1 Exhaustion.

features.name: Superior Dread
features.description: In Form of Dread: resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing; Fly Speed equal to Speed (hover) and move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside); cast Conjuration and Necromancy Warlock spells with no V, S or non-costly M components.

features.name: Despairing Strikes
features.description: You have Despairing Strike Dice: three d8s at level 3, four d10s at 10, five d12s at 15, all regained on a Short or Long Rest. Once per attack, when you hit with a weapon, spend one to add that roll as Psychic damage and optionally an effect (save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus). Abandoned: Intelligence save or Deafened until the end of your next turn, treating every creature it sees as an enemy. Dread: Disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of your next turn.

features.name: Solemn Gaze
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet if you already have it). Empathetic Inquiry: as a Magic action, a creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or you learn an emotion weighing on it (a worry, love, or hate); it knows if it can see you. Wisdom modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Dreaded Appearance
features.description: When you use Tactical Shift you can teleport up to 30 feet instead of moving. Right after, once per Short or Long Rest, each creature you choose in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Wisdom save: on a failure it takes Psychic damage equal to one Despairing Strike die roll and is Frightened until the end of your next turn; on a success, half damage.

features.name: Unsettled Strikes
features.description: New Despairing Strike options. Apathetic: Wisdom save or Incapacitated until the start of your next turn, answering only in single words. Lost: Charisma save or Blinded with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn; on a success its Speed is halved instead. Weary: Constitution save or 1 Exhaustion level (never above 2 from this), removed at the end of your next turn.

features.name: Grim Constitution
features.description: Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic damage. When an effect would reduce your Hit Point maximum, make a DC 15 Constitution save to negate it; the DC rises by 5 for each later attempt and resets to 15 on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Grieving Mantle
features.description: When you use Action Surge, for 1 minute (or until Incapacitated): Shade Form lets you take a Reaction when hit by an attack to reduce its damage to 0, and you are immune to Charmed and Frightened (ending either if present).

features.name: Face of Rage
features.description: While Raging you are unrecognizable to anyone who hasn't seen the change. Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 and can deal Force instead of their normal type; on a hit, push 10 feet or force a Constitution save (DC 8 + Str mod + PB) or Prone. You count as one size larger for Grapples and your Unarmed Strike reach is +5 feet.

features.name: Mask of Civility
features.description: Proficiency in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Persuasion, or Religion, plus one Artisan's Tools or one language.

features.name: Brains and Brawn
features.description: Not Raging: Resistance to Psychic damage. Raging: Resistance to every damage type except Force and Psychic.

features.name: Cunning and Brutal
features.description: Not Raging: Disengage or Help as a Bonus Action. Raging: Unarmed Strikes crit on 19-20.

features.name: Better Half
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when reduced to 0 HP but not killed, drop to 1 HP and gain Temporary HP equal to half your HP maximum (lost after 1 minute). If Raging, the Rage ends; if not, you start Raging even with no uses left.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.description: Summon a spirit beast: Primal Guardian (AC 12 + Con mod, HP 6 + 6 x Barbarian level, Large on land or sea, gains half max HP as temp HP and enrages when Bloodied, Body Block reaction takes damage for an adjacent ally) or Primal Striker (AC 12 + Con mod, HP 5 + 4 x Barbarian level, faster, Advantage on attacks while you Rage). Pick Land, Sea, or Sky for its movement and extras. It adds your PB to checks, attacks, and saves, acts on your turn, Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action (or give up one attack) to command it. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a Rage use; swap it on a Long Rest.

features.name: Shared Rage
features.description: While you Rage, your companion has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

features.name: Kin to Beasts
features.description: Animal Friendship and Speak with Animals always prepared; each once per Short or Long Rest without a slot, or with slots. Constitution is the casting ability.

features.name: Skinrider's Trance
features.description: Once per Long Rest (or spend a Rage use to restore), take a Magic action to possess your companion or a Beast under your Animal Friendship within 60 feet, using its HP, Hit Dice, Str, Dex, Con, Speed and senses. Your body is catatonic. Lasts up to half your Barbarian level + Con mod hours.

features.name: Shape of the Wild
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest (or spend a Rage use), as a Bonus Action change your companion's form; its HP resets to the new maximum.

features.name: Rage of the Dead
features.description: While Raging: ignore Difficult Terrain and move through creatures; +10 feet Speed and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage; see Invisible things within 120 feet and into the Ethereal Plane.

features.name: Final Night Catharsis
features.description: Choose an emotion, changeable on a Long Rest. Hate: after you miss a creature, Advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your next turn. Jealousy: Reaction to impose Disadvantage on a creature's check to escape your Grapple. Terror: while Bloodied, Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Dark Doom Revisited
features.description: Once per Rage, as a Magic action, start an aura for 1 minute; chosen creatures in it make a save at the start of their turns (DC 8 + Con or Str mod + PB) and take a number of d6 equal to your Rage Damage bonus. Contamination (10 ft., Con save): Poison damage and Poisoned. Hypothermia (10 ft., Con save): Cold damage and halved Speed. Immolation (15 ft., Dex save): Fire damage until extinguished.

features.name: Death Is but a Door
features.description: Advantage on Death Saving Throws and you die only after four failures. Once per Long Rest (or spend two Rage uses), cast Cure Wounds, Revivify, or Raise Dead with no Material components, gaining 1, 2, or 3 Exhaustion levels respectively. Constitution is the casting ability.

features.name: Powered by Pathos
features.description: Your Catharsis emotion adds a Raging benefit. Hate: crit on 19-20. Jealousy: Reaction when a creature starts its turn within 30 feet; Str or Dex save or Grappled until the end of its turn, or on a success its movement costs double. Terror: Reaction when a creature starts its turn within 30 feet to halve its Speed and give Opportunity Attacks against it Advantage until its next turn.

features.name: Talented Adventurer
features.description: Learn one adventurer's talent, and one more at Bard levels 6 and 14. Barbarian: 1/Long Rest Bonus Action rampage for 1 minute with B/P/S Resistance (no Heavy armor, no Concentration). Cleric: 1/Short Rest Bonus Action, a creature within 30 feet gains temp HP of half your Bard level + Cha mod for 10 minutes, which it can spend on a hit as extra Radiant damage. Druid: 1/Long Rest Polymorph yourself only, max CR half your Bard level. Fighter: Martial weapons, Shields, and a Fighting Style feat. Monk: unarmored AC 10 + Dex + Cha, Dex for Unarmed Strikes, 1d6 Unarmed Strike, Bonus Action Unarmed Strike after the Attack action or an action spell. Paladin: 1/Short Rest smite with a slot, 1d6 + 1d6 per slot level Radiant (+1d6 vs Fiends and Undead). Ranger: Hunter's Mark prepared, cast at level 5 once per Long Rest without a slot. Rogue: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action. Sorcerer: 1/Short Rest apply one of Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Seeking, Subtle, or Transmuted Spell to a Bard spell. Warlock: one Eldritch Invocation (Bard level counts). Wizard: two extra prepared Wizard spells that count as Bard spells.

features.name: Party Planner
features.description: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can take the Help action as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Well-Rounded
features.description: Proficiency with one Artisan's Tools, one skill, and one language of your choice.

features.name: Improvisational Talent
features.description: On a Long Rest, swap one adventurer's talent for another.

features.name: Antagonistic Antics
features.description: Learn Vicious Mockery (or another Bard cantrip if you have it; it doesn't count against your cantrips) and always have Dissonant Whispers prepared. After you Dash, Disengage, or Influence, you can cast Vicious Mockery as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Cruel Jest
features.description: When a creature you can see or hear within 30 feet fails a D20 Test, take a Reaction and spend a Bardic Inspiration: it takes Psychic damage equal to the roll + Cha mod and has Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the end of its next turn.

features.name: Gallows Humor
features.description: When a creature within 60 feet drops to 0 HP or dies, take a Reaction to regain a Bardic Inspiration use; a creature within 30 feet that hears you makes a Wisdom save or is Prone with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn. If it succeeds you keep this feature; otherwise once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Last Laugh
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when you become Bloodied or take damage while Bloodied, take a Reaction to regain all Bardic Inspiration and gain Resistance to all damage for 1 minute. During that minute, when a creature within 60 feet hits you, spend up to three Inspiration dice: it makes a Charisma save or takes Psychic damage equal to the dice + Cha mod.

features.name: Eldritch Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Detect Thoughts, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, See Invisibility, Sleep; 5 Fear, Tongues; 7 Confusion, Phantasmal Killer; 9 Contact Other Plane, Dream.

features.name: Eldritch Contagion
features.description: When you cast a slot spell with a Magic action that targets creatures, one target makes a Wisdom save or suffers a d8 Eldritch Effect for 1 minute (repeat save each turn; ends if you use this again): 1 can't speak or cast Verbal spells; 2 1d6 Psychic each turn; 3 falls Prone if it moves more than 5 feet; 4 Disadvantage on attacks and Perception; 5 action or Bonus Action, not both, and one attack; 6 Advantage on its attacks and on attacks against it; 7 Deafened and can't see beyond 30 feet; 8 Frightened.

features.name: Prophecy of Doom
features.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: roll an Eldritch Effect; each creature in a 15-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save or suffers it for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).

features.name: Otherworldly Calm
features.description: Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened. Your thoughts can't be read without permission; a creature that tries makes a Wisdom save or takes Psychic damage equal to your Cleric level.

features.name: Sing the Song that Ends the World
features.description: A creature that fails its save against Prophecy of Doom can take 10d10 Psychic damage; it is then immune to this for 10 minutes.

features.name: Cleanse with Fire
features.description: Wis mod + PB times (min 1) per Short or Long Rest, add 1d8 Fire to cantrip damage or a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit.

features.name: Purification Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Detect Poison and Disease, Flame Blade; 5 Fear, Flash Fever; 7 Aura of Purity, Wall of Fire; 9 Flame Strike, Hold Monster.

features.name: Unclean Brand
features.description: On a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a Channel Divinity to brand the target instead of dealing normal damage: for 1 minute it has Disadvantage on saves against your spells and Vulnerability to your Fire damage, even if it resists or is immune.

features.name: Ward Against Corruption
features.description: Advantage on saves against disease and against effects that change your form. As a Magic action, grant this to a willing creature for 1 hour; it takes Fire damage equal to your Wis mod (min 1), ignoring Resistance and Immunity.

features.name: Sear Imperfections
features.description: Cast Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration on a willing creature with no slot and no Material components; it takes 1d6 Fire per spell level, ignoring Resistance and Immunity.

features.name: Circle of Blood Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Blood Rush, Crimson Lash, Sense Lifeblood; 5 Blood Bond, Sanguine Poppet; 7 Circle of Scarlet, Dark Sacrament; 9 Dominate Person, Mortality.

features.name: Rite of the Blood Moon
features.description: Spend a Wild Shape use as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: gain temp HP equal to 3 x Druid level, +10 feet Speed and Dash as a Bonus Action, and your weapon or Unarmed Strike hits can add 1d6 Necrotic.

features.name: Blood Boon
features.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), when a creature within 60 feet drops to 0 HP, take a Reaction to regain 1 Hit Die and give a creature within 60 feet temp HP equal to your Druid level.

features.name: Blood Lust
features.description: During Blood Moon your extra Necrotic becomes 2d6 and you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

features.name: Exsanguinate
features.description: Once per Long Rest, a Blood Boon instead restores Hit Dice equal to half your Druid level and gives up to Wis mod creatures within 60 feet temp HP equal to twice your Druid level.

features.name: Catastrophic Power
features.description: After each Short or Long Rest pick one until the next rest. Elemental Cataclysm: Magic action, spend a slot for a 10-foot-radius Sphere within 60 feet; Dex save, 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning per slot level and Vulnerability to that type for 1 minute (repeat save each turn), half and no Vulnerability on a success. Ruinous Smite: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a slot for 1d8 + 1d8 per slot level Necrotic. Weapon Mastery: use the mastery property of one proficient weapon kind, changeable on a Long Rest.

features.name: Ruin Incarnate
features.description: Spend a Wild Shape use as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Advantage on attacks against Bloodied creatures, two attacks per Attack action, and base AC 17 + Wis mod if higher.

features.name: Many Roads to Ruin
features.description: During Ruin Incarnate, your weapon and Unarmed Strike hits can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Necrotic instead, and you add Wis mod (min +1) to Strength and Dexterity saves.

features.name: Shake the Earth
features.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action grow one size for 10 minutes; each creature in a 30-foot Emanation makes a Dex save or falls Prone, and grounded structures there take Druid-level d10 Bludgeoning. While enlarged, weapon and Unarmed Strike hits deal +1d4.

features.name: Entropy's Apex
features.description: Creatures hit by your Ruinous Smite suffer crits on 19-20 until the end of your next turn; Ruin Incarnate gives three attacks per Attack action; Shake the Earth recharges on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: Wild Shape max CR equals Druid level / 3 (round down), Beast attacks deal +2 damage, and you can Dash, Disengage, or Influence as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Mutate Shape
features.description: On entering Wild Shape, or as a Bonus Action in it, spend a slot to gain Mutation Points equal to its level and spend them on mutations (each once per Wild Shape unless repeatable) until you leave the form. Sea (1, +1 for double): swim speed and water breathing. Sky (3, +2 for 60 ft.): fly 30 ft. Darkvision (1): 60 ft. or +60. Disquieting Voice (1): talk with and Influence Beasts. Echolocation (3): Blindsight 30 ft. Enlarge (2, +2 for two sizes). Manipulate Objects (1): Utilize as a Bonus Action. Multiattack (2): two form attacks per Attack action. Natural Armor (2): +1 AC, up to three times. Reduce (1, +2 for two sizes). Venomous Attacks (2): once per turn +2d6 Poison and Con save or Poisoned 1 minute, up to three times for +2d6 each. Wall Crawler (1, +1 for double): climb speed.

features.name: Unnatural and Unnerving
features.description: Spending a level 2+ slot on Mutation Points returns one lower-level slot (max level 5). In Wild Shape your attacks can deal Force instead, and you have Advantage on Deception, Intimidation, and Animal Handling checks.

features.name: Endless Evolution
features.description: Gain extra Mutation Points equal to Wis mod (min 1). New mutations: Creature of Earth (3, +2 for burrow): Tremorsense 30 ft. Elemental Inurement (2): Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, repeatable for different types. Eldritch Assault (2): +1 to form attack and damage, up to three times. Mystic Monster (3): cast spells in Wild Shape, and at Druid 18 targets have Disadvantage on saves against them. Rapid Regeneration (5): regain Wis mod HP each turn. Supernatural Hide (5): B/P/S Resistance.

features.name: Apex Predator
features.description: Once per turn a form attack hit deals +2d10 Force. As a Magic action, touch a Beast and spend a slot to give it mutations worth the slot level; they last until replaced or ended by Remove Curse or Greater Restoration.

features.name: Protective Taunt
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn (one taunt per creature).

features.name: Weather the Storm
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Bonus Action for 1 minute, gain temp HP equal to Fighter level + Con mod at the end of each of your turns.

features.name: Threatening Presence
features.description: Twice per Long Rest (three times at Fighter 15), as a Magic action, chosen creatures that can hear you in a 30-foot Emanation make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Con mod + PB) or take 5d6 Psychic and have Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you. Using it restores Weather the Storm.

features.name: Aggressive Defense
features.description: Once on each of your turns, when you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend up to half your Fighter level in temp HP to add that much damage.

features.name: Improved Second Wind
features.description: When Second Wind heals you, you also gain temp HP equal to the roll's total.

features.name: Halt the Assault
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, take a Reaction to become the target instead, with Resistance to all of that attack's damage.

features.name: Compound Creator
features.description: Learn three compounds (two more at Fighter 7, 10, and 15, swapping one each time). On a Long Rest with Alchemist's Supplies, make any number; they vanish at the next Long Rest. Drink one as a Bonus Action, up to 1 + Con mod (min 1) per Long Rest; repeats of the same compound don't stack, and anyone else who drinks one makes a Con save (DC 8 + Int mod + PB) or is Poisoned for 1 minute. Options: Adrenal Injection (+10 ft. Speed and a 30-ft. jump for 10 ft. of movement, 1 minute); Allsense Injection (Blindsight 30 ft., 1 minute); Arcane Eye Oil (sense magic within 30 ft., 1 hour); six Draughts (Advantage on checks and saves of one ability, 10 minutes); Elfsight Oil (Darkvision 120 ft., 8 hours); Fleshknit Phosphate (regain PB HP each turn, 1 minute); Ironmind Injection (Advantage against Charmed and Frightened, 1 hour); Liquid Courage (temp HP 2 x Fighter level + Con mod); Liquid Rage (+1d4 weapon and Unarmed Strike damage, 1 minute); Presto Powder (Advantage on Initiative and Bonus Action Dash or Disengage, 10 minutes); Spellshine Ointment (Resistance to Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, 1 minute); Steelskin Ointment (B/P/S Resistance, 1 minute); Tenmen Tincture (one size larger for carrying, and swap a weapon's mastery for Topple, 1 hour).

features.name: Student of Alchemy
features.description: You gain Alchemist's Supplies and proficiency with them, with double Proficiency Bonus on their checks.

features.name: Living Cauldron
features.description: You can safely drink 3 + Con mod compounds per Long Rest (5 + Con mod at Fighter 18).

features.name: Rapid Consumption
features.description: When you drink a compound as a Bonus Action, you can drink a second one.

features.name: Toxin Transmutation
features.description: Resistance to Poison damage. As a Bonus Action end Poisoned on yourself; once per Long Rest doing so grants temp HP equal to your Fighter level.

features.name: Living Catalyst
features.description: On a Long Rest, swap one known compound for another.

features.name: Skilled Guardian
features.description: Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, plus proficiency in two of Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, or Stealth.

features.name: Ever Vigilant
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60). Advantage on Initiative and Wisdom (Perception). Warning Shout: once per Long Rest, when you roll Initiative, take a Reaction so chosen creatures within 30 feet can each use a Reaction to gain Advantage on Initiative and move half their Speed without provoking.

features.name: Size Up
features.description: As a Bonus Action, mark a creature within 30 feet until the start of your next turn; when it attacks you or someone within 5 feet of you, take a Reaction to give that roll Disadvantage and the target Resistance to its damage.

features.name: Night Stalker
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, Bonus Action Blindsight 30 feet for 10 minutes. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage, and you don't provoke them while entirely in Dim Light or Darkness.

features.name: Ready for Action
features.description: Treat Initiative d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10. On an Initiative roll of 18-20, take one extra action (not Magic) on your first turn.

features.name: Beat Down
features.description: Right after you miss a creature you've Sized Up, use a Bonus Action or Reaction to make a melee attack against it with Advantage.

features.name: Subtle Hand
features.description: On your turn your Unarmed Strike reach is +5 feet, and Unarmed Strikes from the Attack action can deal Psychic damage.

features.name: Psionic Prowess
features.description: Learn Mage Hand, cast without Verbal or Somatic components, and its hand can be Invisible. As a Magic action, spend 1 Focus Point to cast Detect Evil and Good or Protection from Evil and Good, or 2 to cast Hold Person, Levitate, or Shatter (Wisdom, no Material components).

features.name: Unsubtle Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit with an Unarmed Strike or Monk weapon, the target makes a Strength save against your Focus save DC or you move it up to 10 feet toward or away from you.

features.name: Psychic Crush
features.description: Each Unarmed Strike hit gives the target a Pressure Point (lost after 1 minute or when you mark another creature). Bonus Action, 1 Focus Point: it makes a Strength save; failure deals 1d8 Force per Point and Restrained until the end of your next turn, success half damage.

features.name: Psionic Mastery
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 5 Focus Points to cast Dispel Evil and Good, Hold Monster, Telekinesis, or Wall of Force (Wisdom, no Material components).

features.name: Tall Tales
features.description: Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.

features.name: Bruised Ego
features.description: When you spend a Focus Point, gain temp HP equal to Wis mod (min 1), doubled while Bloodied.

features.name: Assertive Attacker
features.description: While Bloodied, add Wis mod to Unarmed Strike and Monk weapon damage.

features.name: Irrational Retaliation
features.description: When a creature damages you, take a Reaction and spend 1 Focus Point to gain Advantage on attacks against it until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Redoubled Efforts
features.description: When you crit while Bloodied, roll one extra damage die.

features.name: Ever Prideful
features.description: When dropped to 0 HP but not killed, spend 1 Focus Point to enter a trance: immune to Unconscious, can't speak or cast or concentrate, and a crit counts as only one failed Death Save. Spend 1 Focus Point each turn you start at 0 HP to keep it; you still make Death Saves.

features.name: Egotistical
features.description: You count as Bloodied whenever you are below your Hit Point maximum.

features.name: Shade of Regret
features.description: Once per turn, spend 1 Focus Point (no action) to create an intangible shade within 10 feet until the end of your next turn. Flurry of Blows attacks can originate from it, dealing Necrotic or Force. Move it up to 60 feet as a Bonus Action.

features.name: The Road Not Traveled
features.description: When you Dash, you can instead teleport yourself or an ally within 60 feet to your shade's location.

features.name: Aid Not Given
features.description: Help as a Bonus Action, or spend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature and heal one Martial Arts die + Wis mod.

features.name: Crushing Guilt
features.description: Spend 3 Focus Points: chosen creatures in a 20-foot Emanation from you or your shade make a Wisdom save; failure deals three Martial Arts dice Psychic and Prone, success half damage.

features.name: Relive the Past
features.description: Your shade lasts 10 minutes, makes one extra Unarmed Strike after Flurry of Blows, and can deliver Stunning Strike.

features.name: Debilitating Fever
features.description: On a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a Channel Divinity: the target is Poisoned and Incapacitated for 1 minute, repeating a Constitution save each turn.

features.name: Entropic Infection
features.description: Magic action, spend a Channel Divinity on a creature within 30 feet: for 1 minute your damage to it adds 2d6 Necrotic and it loses Necrotic Resistance and Immunity (Constitution save each turn ends it).

features.name: Oath of Pestilence Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Bane, Inflict Wounds; 5 Melf's Acid Arrow, Ray of Enfeeblement; 9 Flash Fever, Stinking Cloud; 13 Blight, Confusion; 17 Contagion, Insect Plague.

features.name: Aura of Rampant Sickness
features.description: When a creature in your Aura of Protection is about to make a D20 Test, take a Reaction to give it Disadvantage.

features.name: Disgusting Resilience
features.description: When dropped to 0 HP but not killed, spend and roll Hit Dice to reduce the damage by the total. If you die, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation makes a Constitution save, taking 8d6 Necrotic or half on a success.

features.name: Plaguebringer
features.description: Once per Long Rest (or spend a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: immune to Poison and Poisoned, Resistance to Necrotic, HP maximum can't be reduced, and enemies starting their turn in your aura take Necrotic equal to Cha mod + PB.

features.name: Frenzied Slaughter
features.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to frenzy until the end of your next turn: when you miss with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, take a Reaction to attack again, and Advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened, and Stunned. Extend it each turn by attacking an enemy, forcing an enemy's save, or ending your turn Bloodied, up to 1 minute; it ends if you're Incapacitated.

features.name: Oath of Slaughter Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Crimson Lash, Inflict Wounds; 5 Bloodletter, Shatter; 9 Fear, Suffocate; 13 Consume Mind, Supernal Smite; 17 Destructive Wave, Incite Riot.

features.name: Bloodthirst Aura
features.description: Bloodied allies in your Aura of Protection add your Cha mod to weapon and Unarmed Strike damage. Take a Reaction to give a Bloodied creature in the aura Disadvantage on a save against a Sangromancy spell.

features.name: Follow Through
features.description: When a creature in your Aura of Protection becomes Bloodied, take a Reaction to move half your Speed without provoking and make a melee attack with Advantage.

features.name: Blood Knight
features.description: Once per Long Rest (or spend a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: gain 30 temp HP whenever an enemy Bloodies a creature in your aura; take a Reaction to attack a creature that hits you; and on a melee hit, chosen creatures within 5 feet of the target and in your reach take Force equal to Cha mod (min 1) + PB.

features.name: Envenomed Attack
features.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action, poison a weapon or up to 20 ammunition for 1 minute: +1d4 Poison on hits. At Ranger 11, 2d4 and uses return on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Toxic Tradecraft
features.description: Poisoner's Kit with proficiency and double PB on its checks; rebuild a lost kit with an hour of foraging during a rest. Once per turn when your weapon deals Poison damage, spend a slot for +1d6 Poison and Poisoned until the end of your next turn, plus a Toxin Effect by slot level. Level 1: Attenuate (Disadvantage on Str and Dex saves), Befuddled (can't speak, read or write; Disadvantage on Concentration), Uncoordinated (no Reactions, Disengage, or Dodge). Level 2: Debilitate (no healing 1 minute), Potent (loses Poison Resistance 1 minute), Suffer (+1d6 the first Poison damage each turn for 1 minute). Level 3: Lingering (Poisoned 10 minutes, save each turn with Disadvantage), Supernatural (loses Poisoned Immunity and is Poisoned 1 minute). Level 4: Flesh Eating (Poisoned 1 minute, 2d6 Acid each turn), Insensate (also Blinded and Deafened), Paraplegia (Speed 0, Disadvantage on Dex saves). Level 5: Enhanced (a level 4 effect plus a level 1 or 2 effect) or Stinging Application (once per turn +5d6 Acid, Necrotic, or Poison for 1 minute).

features.name: Green Reaper Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Detect Poison and Disease; 5 Hold Person; 9 Bestow Curse; 13 Greater Invisibility; 17 Cloudkill.

features.name: Poison Control
features.description: Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves against Poisoned. Cast Protection from Poison without a slot Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Variegated Vexations
features.description: Your weapon Poison damage can be Acid or Necrotic instead.

features.name: Pain Tolerance
