features.description: If you have Weapon Mastery with a Battleaxe, Longsword, or Spear, once on each of your turns add your Proficiency Bonus to a damage roll with it.

features.name: Savage Charge
features.description: As an Attack action, move up to your Speed and make one melee attack. On a hit, a Bonus Action Dash lets you pass through the target's space without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Call of the Northlands
features.description: At the end of a Long Rest choose one (replacing the previous): Dragonslayer (Advantage on attacks against Dragons), Hardy Swimmer (Swim Speed equal to Speed), Inured to Cold (Resistance to Cold), or Trollslayer (Advantage on attacks against Giants).

features.name: Marauder's Reprisal
features.description: When you become Bloodied or take a Critical Hit, use your Reaction to attack an enemy in reach; a hit is a Critical Hit and grants Temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Unstoppable Assault
features.description: As an action once per Long Rest, attack additional times equal to half your Proficiency Bonus beyond your normal attacks; hits from these are Critical Hits and push the target 10 feet unless it succeeds on a Strength save (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Strength modifier).

features.name: Tenets of Valhalla
features.description: Protect the worthy dead. Inspire courage in battle. Bring justice to those who make a mockery of the dead.

features.name: Encouraging Smite
features.description: Right after casting Divine Smite, expend a Channel Divinity: creatures of your choice within 30 feet have Advantage on attacks and saves against the target until the start of your next turn, and their attacks against it deal an extra 1d4 Thunder.

features.name: Guardian of the Dead
features.description: As a Bonus Action, expend a Channel Divinity for 1 hour: within 10 feet of a creature at 0 Hit Points you have Advantage on attacks and on saves against Charmed or Frightened (Immunity to Charmed once you have Aura of Courage). When a creature you can see casts a spell to create Undead or restore life, take a Reaction to move half your Speed and attack it.

features.name: Oath of Valhalla Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Heroism, Searing Smite; 5 Gentle Repose, Shining Smite; 9 Beacon of Hope, Glyph of Warding (Thunder); 13 Aura of Purity, Guardian of Faith; 17 Flame Strike, Hallow.

features.name: Thunderous Aura
features.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Immunity to Thunder damage. Your Find Steed mount's attacks can deal Thunder damage.

features.name: Valorous Soul
features.description: When you reduce a foe to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack, allies of your choice within 60 feet have Advantage on attacks and saves for 1 minute. If you die, your body is preserved as by Gentle Repose, and you may refuse to be raised.

features.name: Spirit of the Valkyrie
features.description: As a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Fly Speed 60 feet; Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects; creatures in your Aura of Protection that try to create or summon Undead must succeed on a Charisma save or fail; Smite spells cast with any slot act as level 5; and enemies starting their turn in your aura take Thunder damage equal to your Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus and must make a Constitution save or be Stunned until the end of their next turn. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

features.name: Spirit Caller Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Bane, Bless, Heroism, Protection from Evil and Good; 5 Augury, Healing Spirit; 7 Speak with Dead, Spirit Guardians; 9 Aura of Life, Death Ward.

features.name: Occult Expertise
features.description: Proficiency in Arcana and Religion, and you can use Charisma instead of Intelligence for them.

features.name: Spirit Guidance
features.description: As a Bonus Action, give yourself Advantage on a skill check. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Spirit Aura
features.description: As a Bonus Action, create a 10-foot spirit aura around you or a willing ally for 1 minute. Maddening Whispers: an enemy entering or starting its turn there makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks until the end of its next turn. Bolstering Whispers: allies entering or starting there have Advantage on ability checks and attacks until the end of their next turn. Twice per Long Rest, or again for 3 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Spiritual Secrets
features.description: When you fail an ability check, attack roll, or save, reroll and take the new result. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest; spend 3 Sorcery Points for another.

features.name: Spiritual Storm
features.description: Your spirit aura extends 15 feet, and enemies entering or starting their turn in it take 2d8 Psychic (once per turn).

features.name: Context Switch
features.description: When a creature makes a melee attack against you, take a Reaction to swap places with a creature within 5 feet (Wisdom save if unwilling); it becomes the target and takes the damage, and an enemy so targeted has Disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Trickster Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Enlarge/Reduce, Magic Mouth, Silent Image; 5 Nondetection, Slow; 7 Compulsion, Confusion; 9 Animate Objects, Modify Memory.

features.name: Nimble Trickery
features.description: Proficiency in Sleight of Hand, and Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks to swap an item for one of similar size. At level 6 you can swap with an unattended object up to 30 feet away; at level 14 you can replace it with a 1-minute illusion instead. Once per Long Rest, or restore by expending a Pact Magic slot.

features.name: Distant Switch
features.description: Context Switch can target a creature within 30 feet, or the swapped creature has Disadvantage on its save. If the target fails, you can have the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell.

features.name: Painful Unreality
features.description: You automatically succeed on Study checks to tell if something is illusory. When a creature interacts with your Illusion spell and fails to see through it, you can force a Wisdom save: 4d10 Psychic and Stunned until the end of its next turn, or half damage only.

features.name: Harbinger of Chaos
features.description: As a Bonus Action, announce changes to reality. Enemies that can see and hear you make an Intelligence save; on a failure they have Disadvantage on d20 tests until the end of their next turn, and you and your allies have Advantage on attacks and d20 tests against them. Once per Short Rest.

features.name: Cat Whisperer
features.description: You can understand and talk with felines, use any Influence action skill option with them, and have Advantage on those checks.

features.name: Feline Nature
features.description: Climb Speed equal to your Speed; when you fall while not Incapacitated you land on your feet and subtract up to 20 feet from the fall for damage. Nine Lives: when reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed, immediately use Second Wind (no action) before falling Unconscious.

features.name: Outsized Trickery
features.description: You can Shove creatures of any size. On a failed save, a pushed target goes 5 feet farther and takes Bludgeoning equal to half your Fighter level (round up) + Strength modifier; a knocked-Prone target takes Bludgeoning equal to half your Fighter level (round up).

features.name: Pouncing Fighting Style
features.description: This subclass can take the Pouncing Fighting Style feat: after moving 15 feet or more toward a creature, +2 to your next melee or Unarmed Strike attack against it, or +2 to the DC of your Grapple or Shove.

features.name: Evasive Maneuvers
features.description: Deft Cover: Half Cover while at least two Small or larger enemies are within 5 feet. Nimble Redirect: once per Short or Long Rest, when hit by a weapon or Unarmed Strike, take a Reaction to reduce the damage by your Fighter level and deal that much to a creature or object within 5 feet.

features.name: Vigilant Reflexes
features.description: You can't be surprised unless Incapacitated. Right after rolling Initiative, take a Reaction to move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and Hide as part of it.

features.name: Cautious Tenacity
features.description: Two more uses of Second Wind, and using it grants the Dodge action's benefits until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Swatting Flurry
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a Melee weapon as part of the Attack action, make up to five more attack rolls against that target with it, stopping at the first miss; each hit deals 1d10 of the weapon's type with no added damage or effects.

features.name: Beyond Coincidence
features.description: You have Fortune Dice (d20s) equal to half your Rogue level (round up), regained on a Long Rest. Spend one for a Luck check: a Charisma check with Expertise that nothing can modify. Favored Talent: replace any ability check with a Luck check. Lucky Break: as a Magic action, describe a lucky turn of events; the GM sets a DC by likelihood (5 to 9 extremely plausible, up to 30+ nearly impossible) and it happens on a success. Discuss this subclass with your GM first.

features.name: Cup Half Full
features.description: When you or a creature within 60 feet rolls a 20 on a meaningful D20 Test, regain one Fortune Die.

features.name: Lucky Strike
features.description: Spend a Fortune Die to make a Luck check in place of an attack roll; a hit triggers Sneak Attack even if it otherwise wouldn't (once per turn). Withdraw on this attack costs no Sneak Attack dice.

features.name: Boon of Fortuity
features.description: After a Long Rest roll two d20s and record them. Once per turn, before targets roll, replace the DC of a save forced by a creature you can see with one of these rolls. Unused rolls are lost on a Long Rest.

features.name: The Skin of Your Teeth
features.description: Roll three d20s for Boon of Fortuity. When you or an ally within 60 feet takes 100 damage or less, replace the damage with one of your fortuitous rolls.

features.name: Your Coven
features.description: Choose a coven: Crowsworn, Cloud Cap Coven, Fish Head Coven, League of the Gilded Gourd, Patchwork Robe Coven, or The Tall Hats. It sets your Coven's Bond and Voice of the Many options.

features.name: Coven Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Bless, Borrow Magic, Mirror Image, Shared Vision; 5 Bestow Curse, Clairvoyance; 7 Pacify Monster, Polymorph; 9 Awaken, Telepathic Bond.

features.name: Collective Knowledge
features.description: Borrowed Talent: once per Long Rest, gain proficiency with a skill or tool you are checking (no action), or learn a language as a Magic action, until your next Long Rest. Spell Swap: once per Long Rest, a 10-minute ritual lets you ask a coven witch one yes/no question and swap a prepared level 1+ Warlock spell for a Druid or Wizard spell of the same or lower level until your next Long Rest, casting it once without a slot.

features.name: Coven's Bond
features.description: Once per Long Rest as a Bonus Action, bond with a creature within 60 feet for 1 hour, using its effect up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) times. Crowsworn or Fish Head: bond an enemy; when you take damage, halve it and the bound creature takes the same amount. Cloud Cap or Tall Hats: bond a willing creature; when either of you fails a save, the other can make it and lend the result. Gilded Gourd or Patchwork Robe: bond a willing creature; as a Bonus Action teleport to it, bring it to you, or swap places within 60 feet.

features.name: Distant Protections
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when an enemy deals you 10 or more damage, take a Reaction to regain 1d10 + Charisma modifier Hit Points and gain +5 AC, the Invisible condition, or a Fly Speed equal to your Speed until the end of your next turn. It triggers automatically when you drop to 0 but aren't killed.

features.name: Voice of the Many
features.description: Once per Long Rest, by coven. Fish Head or Gilded Gourd: as a Magic action, cast a level 6 or lower Druid or Wizard Evocation spell (not a Reaction spell) without a slot or Material components. Cloud Cap or Crowsworn: as a Bonus Action roll three d6 and assign them as bonuses to AC and two saves for 1 minute. Patchwork Robe or Tall Hats: when you or a creature you can see is targeted by a spell of level 6 or lower, take a Reaction to make it also target any other creature you can see.

features.name: Galvanic Heart
features.description: Resistance to Lightning damage (if you already have it, also reduce Lightning damage by d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus). Vessel save DC is 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Vessel Damage is d4s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, always Lightning.

features.name: Unbound Storm
features.description: While raging: Electrified Chains (Bonus Action; your next hit this turn deals Vessel Damage and ensnares the target until your next turn, and moving more than 10 feet requires an Athletics check against your DC or it takes Vessel Damage and its Speed drops to 0); Fulgurant Strike (after a melee hit, a Bonus Action calls lightning through your weapon: Vessel Damage to the target and creatures in a 10-foot Emanation that fail a Dexterity save); Lightning Step (Bonus Action move half your Speed, dealing Vessel Damage to one creature within 5 feet where you stop).

features.name: Roaring Crash
features.description: As part of entering Rage, leap to a space within 30 feet not occupied by a Huge or larger creature; creatures in a 10-foot Emanation make a Dexterity save, twice your Vessel Damage or half. A creature in the landing space has Disadvantage and is pushed 5 feet (or knocked Prone). 60 feet and Huge spaces at level 10; 90 feet and any creature at 14.

features.name: Lightning Reflexes
features.description: Add your Constitution modifier (minimum +1) to Dexterity checks, including Initiative. While raging, Lightning Step once per turn costs no Bonus Action.

features.name: Electric Beast
features.description: Add your Constitution modifier to Vessel Damage. Chains trigger on 5 feet of movement and also deny Reactions; Fulgurant Strike's Emanation is 20 feet and spares up to your Constitution modifier creatures; Lightning Step moves your full Speed and can teleport.

features.name: Circle of Symbiosis Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Arm Cannon, Calcified Memories, Fractured Shell, Phalangeal Shot, Shillelagh; 5 Displacing Maw, Osseous Impalement; 7 Dread Scarecrow, Maiden of Bones; 9 Forest of Dread, Tree Stride.

features.name: Grafted Powers
features.description: Choose one: Bear Back (count one size larger for carrying and grappling, and add Wisdom to Strength checks), Deer Head (Advantage on Perception), or Goat Hooves (Advantage against Prone and a Climb Speed equal to your Speed).

features.name: Wickerbone Behemoth
features.description: As a Bonus Action without armor or Shield, spend a Wild Shape use to become a behemoth for 10 minutes: your arms are Shillelagh Clubs whose mastery you can use, you are under Barkskin without Concentration, creatures of your choice within 5 feet take 1d4 Piercing when they damage you with an attack (2d4 at level 10), and at the start of each turn you regain half the damage taken since your last turn (up to five times your Proficiency Bonus).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action, and you can replace one attack with a cantrip.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.description: You are permanently under Barkskin. While a behemoth you are Large, and taking the Attack action gives Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing until the end of your next turn (lost early if you take Fire damage).

features.name: Briarheart
features.description: While a behemoth your arms also use the Nick mastery, and after taking the Attack action you can cast an action-time Osteomancy spell as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Blood Strike
features.description: Learn three Blood Strike options (one more at levels 5, 9, 13, and 17; swap one each time). Once per turn on an Attack action weapon attack, apply one; you take its Blood Cost in unpreventable Necrotic damage. Uses equal to 1 + Constitution modifier per Short or Long Rest; save DC 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Options: Bewitching (1d8: +2d6 Psychic and Wisdom save or it treats an ally as an enemy), Bloodboil (1d6: 2d6 Fire ignoring Resistance in a 10-foot Emanation and burning), Bloodshard (1d8: a 60-foot Line, Dexterity save for weapon damage +1d6 Piercing or half), Constraining (1d8: +2d6 Acid, Disadvantage on its next attack, and a Dexterity save or 2d6 Acid when it moves), Exiling (1d10: Charisma save or banished until the end of its next turn), Hunting (1d4: ignores AC from armor, Shields, and magic; +1d6 Slashing and you track it for a minute), Shadowblood (1d6: +2d6 Necrotic and magical Darkness in 10 feet), Thunderblood (1d4: +2d6 Thunder, pushed 15 feet, Strength save or Prone), Withering (1d6: +2d6 Necrotic and Constitution save or its damage is halved). Damage dice improve at level 18.

features.name: Blood Hound Anatomy
features.description: Immune to magical contagions, Resistance to Poison damage, and Advantage on saves against Poisoned. Advantage on Investigation, Perception, and Survival checks to find a creature with blood that you have damaged.

features.name: Blood Armament
features.description: Your wielded weapon is blood-coated and can deal Acid, Necrotic, or Poison damage instead of its normal type.

features.name: Blood Explosion
features.description: When you miss with a blood-coated weapon, a Bonus Action detonates it: the target and others in a 5-foot Emanation make a Constitution save, taking weapon damage or half.

features.name: Blood of Creation
features.description: Reroll a Blood Cost and take the lower result, and swap one Blood Strike option after each Long Rest.

features.name: Blood Symphony
features.description: Using a Blood Strike heals you by your Constitution modifier (minimum 1), and a target that dies within 1 minute of a Blood Strike restores a use.

features.name: Improved Blood Strike
features.description: Your Blood Strike options deal more damage, as noted in each option.

features.name: Tenets of the Eldritch Hunt
features.description: Resolve, Respect, Responsibility.

features.name: Hunt the Prey
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity to mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; then and as a Bonus Action on later turns, teleport up to 60 feet to a space within 5 feet of it while you can see it. If it drops to 0, move the mark to another creature within 60 feet.

features.name: Oath of the Eldritch Hunt Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Faerie Fire, Spectral Slash; 5 Hold Person, Moonbeam; 9 Displacing Maw, Spectral Fury; 13 Evard's Black Tentacles, Maiden of Bones; 17 Contact Other Plane, Hold Monster.

features.name: Stolen Eldritch Gift
features.description: Add your Charisma modifier to Athletics, Perception, and Survival checks.

features.name: Sharpened Senses
features.description: You learn the Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities of creatures in your Aura of Protection, and have Blindsight within its range.

features.name: Relentless Pursuit
features.description: When you hit your marked target with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike right after teleporting with Hunt the Prey, cast Divine Smite without a Bonus Action (once per turn).

features.name: Perfect Hunter
features.description: As a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: weapon attacks deal +1d8 Necrotic ignoring Resistance and Immunity; Immunity to Grappled, Paralyzed, and Restrained; and the Invisible condition. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 5 slot.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Proficiency and Expertise with Torture Tools and Insight. An hour with the tools on a Restrained creature inflicts Exhaustion (and possibly 10 damage on a failed Dexterity check against 20 minus its Constitution modifier), and Intimidation against a creature you've used them on gets +twice your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Torturer Techniques
features.description: With Torture Tools at hand, add one technique to a melee or Unarmed Strike hit once per turn; each technique twice per Long Rest (spend a Favored Enemy use to restore one). Empower by expending a slot (level 1 at Ranger 3 up to level 5 at 17) for extra damage of Wisdom modifier times slot level and -1d4 per slot level on the target's save. Save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Combing (+1d10 Slashing; from level 7, two rounds running causes decay), Enucleation (+1d6 and Constitution save or Disadvantage on Perception and Blinded beyond 60 feet), Hamstringing (+1d6 Slashing and Constitution save or Speed 0 until your next turn), Nerve Scraping (+1d4 Psychic and Constitution save or it must attack a random creature), Throat Chop (+1d8 Bludgeoning and it can't speak or cast verbal spells; from level 11, two rounds running can Stun), Tympanic Rupture (+1d8 Bludgeoning and Constitution save or Deafened for 1 minute).

features.name: Depraved Mind
features.description: Immunity to Frightened and Resistance to Psychic. A creature trying to read or speak into your mind against your will must succeed on a Wisdom save or take Psychic damage equal to your level and fail.

features.name: Veil of Pain
features.description: When a technique damages a creature, it makes a Wisdom save or you are Invisible to it for 1 minute (save each turn). Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Mental Agony
features.description: When a creature within 60 feet that failed a save against your technique since your last turn makes an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, take a Reaction to make it subtract 1d10 (not against Fright-immune creatures).

features.name: Sanctified Champion
features.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor. After a Short Rest, sanctify a Piercing or Slashing melee weapon: it has Finesse for you and ignores Resistance of Aberrations, Fiends, and Undead.

features.name: Divine Blessings
features.description: Divine Points equal to 1 + Wisdom modifier per Short or Long Rest, and regain one when your sanctified blade kills an Aberration, Beast, Fiend, or Undead of CR 1/2+. Save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Armor of the Faithful (Reaction, 1: the attacker makes a Wisdom save or must retarget and can't target you until your next turn); Divine Inspiration (1: reroll a History, Religion, or Insight check and add your Wisdom modifier); Rend the Blasphemous (Bonus Action after attacking, 1: another blade attack adding your Wisdom modifier to hit).

features.name: Righteous Armament
features.description: Chains of Judgement (1 on a hit: Strength save or Radiant equal to Wisdom modifier and Restrained until the end of your next turn); Divine Retaliation (Reaction, 1: when hit in melee, attack back adding your Wisdom modifier to damage); Erupting Blades (2, forgoing Sneak Attack: a 45-foot Line takes your Sneak Attack damage as Radiant, Dexterity save for half).

features.name: Saintly Revelations
features.description: Learn two Cleric cantrips. Heroism, Protection from Evil and Good, and Shield of Faith are always prepared and castable at will on yourself without slots or components (Wisdom); from level 17 they need no Concentration but only one is active at a time.

features.name: Final Judgement
features.description: Divine Spirits: once per Long Rest (or 3 Divine Points), cast Spirit Guardians without a slot; creatures in it count as next to an ally for Sneak Attack. Radiant Blade: on command your blade sheds light 30 feet, counts as magic, and deals +2d4 Radiant.

features.name: Brittle Bone Armor
features.description: As an action without armor or Shield, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wizard level for 1 hour; while they last you have Resistance to Piercing and Slashing and +2 AC. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 2+ slot.

features.name: Anatomical Expert
features.description: Proficiency in Medicine; add your Intelligence modifier to Medicine and Survival checks, with Expertise when they concern a creature with a skeleton.

features.name: Bone Puppetry
features.description: As a Magic action, a creature with a skeleton within 60 feet makes a Strength save or you control its actions until the end of its next turn (it attacks allies with Disadvantage and they have Advantage on saves against it). One at a time; Intelligence modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Skeletal Mastery
features.description: Cast Alter Self without a slot or Concentration (Change Appearance or Natural Weapons only). As a Magic action dissolve or restore your skeleton: boneless you have Speed 10, squeeze through 1-inch gaps, count as Prone, and can't use hands, attack, or cast (a Bonus Action regrows hand bones until your next turn).

features.name: Improved Bone Puppetry
features.description: Control lasts 1 minute with full obedience (save each turn), requiring Concentration that damage can't break; spend another use to impose Disadvantage on its save.

features.name: Instinctual Divination
features.description: When you take the Study action to make an Arcana or Religion check, you can make it as a Wisdom (Survival) check instead.

features.name: Spell Hammer
features.description: Once per turn while raging, deal double your Rage Damage bonus with a Strength-based hit, or triple against a target that has Legendary Actions, can cast spells, or was summoned.

features.name: Spell Shield
features.description: While raging, you and allies in a 30-foot Emanation add your Rage Damage bonus to saves against spells.

features.name: Sunder the Weave
features.description: Counterspell is always prepared; once per Short or Long Rest while raging cast it without a slot or components (Strength), and as part of that Reaction move up to your Speed and make one weapon attack against the caster.

features.name: Bolstering Howl
features.description: When you or a creature that can hear you takes damage, take a Reaction to give it Resistance to that damage and that type until the end of the turn.

features.name: Dimensional Duel
features.description: Banishment is always prepared. When you rage or as a Bonus Action while raging, cast it without a slot or components (Strength) on up to three creatures, maintaining Concentration while raging, and you can follow them into a lit demiplane of 30 to 200 feet where they aren't Incapacitated. Strength modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Tragic Hero
features.description: When you fail a save, other creatures you choose within 60 feet add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to their saves against the same effect.

features.name: One Life, Many Roles
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest as a Bonus Action, cast Disguise Self; copying a creature you can see also copies its mannerisms and voice.

features.name: Stage Direction
features.description: When a creature that can see you would roll your Bardic Inspiration die, it uses the die's maximum instead. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Assemble the Troupe
features.description: Your One Life, Many Roles Disguise Self can also disguise up to six willing creatures within 30 feet as you choose, and disguised creatures add your Charisma modifier to Charisma checks.

features.name: Grand Finale
features.description: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, up to two other creatures within 60 feet that see or hear you can immediately take an action.

features.name: Apocalypse Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Darkness, Hellish Rebuke, Phantasmal Force, Thunderwave; 5 Doom, Fear; 7 Blight, Ice Storm; 9 Antilife Shell, Insect Plague.

features.name: Visions of Annihilation
features.description: As a Bonus Action, attacks against a creature you can see within 120 feet have Advantage until the start of your next turn. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Doom Song
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity: for 10 minutes attacks against a creature you can see within 120 feet crit on 19 or 20.

features.name: All Will Be Dust
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity: a creature you can see within 120 feet has Disadvantage on its next save against your spells before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Life Beyond Death
features.description: When you or an ally within 120 feet is about to make a Death Saving Throw, expend a spell slot (no action) to heal it ten times the slot level.

features.name: Circle of the Symbiote Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Barkskin, Entangle, Guidance; 5 Plant Growth; 7 Hallucinatory Terrain; 9 Tree Stride.

features.name: Primal Symbiote
features.description: Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration. Symbiotic Transformation: as a Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape use for 1 minute of +2 AC, Temporary Hit Points of 2 + half your Druid level at the start of each turn, and Advantage on Stealth.

features.name: Symbiotic Reflexes
features.description: Haste is always prepared, and once per Symbiotic Transformation you can cast it on yourself without a slot or components.

features.name: Survival Instinct
features.description: While Incapacitated you can still Dash, Disengage, or Dodge, and keep the Dodge benefits while Incapacitated.

features.name: Surge of Sustenance
features.description: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, spend a Wild Shape use to give yourself or a creature you touch the benefits of a Short Rest.

features.name: Bolstering Presence
features.description: At the start of your turn (no action), creatures of your choice within 30 feet that see or hear you regain 2d6 + half your Fighter level Hit Points. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Heroic Effort
features.description: At the end of a creature's turn, take a Reaction to move your Speed and make one attack; then an ally within 30 feet can use its Reaction to do the same. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Lead by Example
features.description: Heroic Effort ends Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned on you and on the ally you choose.

features.name: Inspiring Presence
features.description: Creatures you bolster add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to D20 Tests and damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Durable Presence
features.description: Bolstering Presence recharges on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Mighty Effort
features.description: Heroic Effort can include up to three allies.

features.name: Guardian of the Way Technique
features.description: Once per turn when a Flurry of Blows Unarmed Strike deals damage: Anchoring Strike (the target can't teleport or travel between planes until the end of your next turn) or Banishing Strike (teleport the target up to 15 feet to a space you can see).

features.name: Seeker
features.description: Detect Magic and Comprehend Languages are always prepared; once per Long Rest (or for 1 Focus Point) cast one without a slot or components (Wisdom).

features.name: Warden of Harmony
features.description: When a creature within 60 feet tries to teleport, take a Reaction and spend 1 Focus Point to stop it.

features.name: Cosmic Restoration
features.description: Once per Long Rest (or for 4 Focus Points), as a Bonus Action touch a willing creature to end spells of your choice on it, or remove Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned, or one Exhaustion level.

features.name: Ward the Profane
features.description: Once per turn on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 3 Focus Points to cast Banishment on the target (Wisdom).

features.name: Tenets of the Guardian
features.description: Choose up to four ideals matching your alignment, such as Courage, Sacrifice, Service, Fidelity, Protection, Affinity, Beauty, Freedom, Dominance, Opportunism, or Profit.

features.name: Oath of the Guardian Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Alarm, Shield of Faith; 5 Lesser Restoration, Warding Bond; 9 Beacon of Hope, Protection from Energy; 13 Death Ward, Guardian of Faith; 17 Greater Restoration, Raise Dead.

features.name: Defensive Intervention
features.description: When a creature you can see hits another creature within 30 feet with an attack roll, take a Reaction and spend a Channel Divinity to teleport up to 30 feet into range and become the target.

features.name: Marking Strike
features.description: When you hit with a weapon, forgo its mastery to mark the target until the end of your next turn: it has Disadvantage on attacks against others and spends 2 feet per foot moving away from you.

features.name: Guarding Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, up to your Charisma modifier creatures within 5 feet use your AC while they stay within 5 feet.

features.name: Inspiring Defense
features.description: You and creatures under your Guarding Presence make two attacks with each Opportunity Attack.

features.name: Ward of the Guardian
features.description: When a creature you've marked drops an ally to 0 without killing it, take a Reaction to leave the ally at 1 Hit Point, and it can use its Reaction to make a melee attack against the marked creature. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Guardian Angel
features.description: Once per Long Rest (or with a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: Guarding Presence becomes a 100-foot Emanation, you regain a Channel Divinity on any turn you have none, and once per round use Ward of the Guardian without a Reaction.

features.name: Trail Warden Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Goodberry; 5 Pass Without Trace; 9 Spirit Guardians; 13 Guardian of Faith; 17 Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Coordinated Tactics
features.description: Roll your Teamwork Die (d6; d8 at level 11, d10 at 17) at the start of each turn. Coordinated Strikes: when another creature you can see hits, take a Reaction to add the die to the damage. Coordinated Tactics: after rolling, willing creatures within 60 feet that see you can use their Reactions to move up to five times the roll (or their Speed) without provoking or Difficult Terrain.

features.name: Lead the Way
features.description: When you succeed on a check with a skill you have Expertise in, chosen creatures within 60 feet add your Teamwork Die to the same check until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Tactical Assault
features.description: Allies you move with Coordinated Tactics also gain one: Guardian Maneuver (reduce the first damage they take by the Teamwork Die) or Recon Maneuver (Hide as part of the move, adding the die to Stealth).

features.name: Coordinated Effort
features.description: When you roll Initiative and aren't Incapacitated, roll the Teamwork Die; you and allies within 30 feet that see or hear you add it to Initiative.

features.name: Group Assault
features.description: When all your attacks in an Attack action target one creature, chosen creatures within 60 feet add your Teamwork Die to one attack and damage roll against it.

features.name: Shadowy Reflection
features.description: As a Magic action, detach your shadow into a space within 5 feet; later control it as a Magic action or with your Cunning Action, moving it your Speed to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors, or carry up to 10 pounds. It can't attack and vanishes if damaged, targeted, or you are Incapacitated.

features.name: Shadow Motes
features.description: You have Shadow Motes equal to your Rogue level per Long Rest, regaining one when you drop a hostile creature to 0. Shadow Scout (1: as a Magic action, see and hear through your shadow for 1 minute up to 120 feet away); Shadow Swap (1, with Cunning Action: swap places with your shadow); Vexing Shadow (1, after a weapon hit with your shadow within 5 feet of the target: you are Invisible to it until the end of your next turn).

features.name: Shadowed Succor
features.description: Once per Long Rest, Uncanny Dodge reduces the damage to 0.

features.name: Shadow Gate
features.description: As a Bonus Action with your shadow within 5 feet, spend 4 Shadow Motes to cast Dimension Door (Intelligence); your shadow travels too.

features.name: True Shadow
features.description: Once per Long Rest as a Bonus Action, your shadow becomes a substantial duplicate for 1 hour that can Attack, Hide, or Utilize using your statistics when you control it, and your attacks against creatures within 5 feet of it have Advantage.

features.name: Innate Darkness Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Confounding Shadows, Darkness, Tide of Darkness, Umbral Tendril; 5 Fear, Shadowy Eruption; 7 Black Tentacles, Greater Invisibility; 9 Mislead, Summon Shadow.

features.name: Shadowed Soul
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet), and you can see through magical Darkness you create with your Innate Darkness spells unless Blinded or Incapacitated.

features.name: Friends to Darkness
features.description: When you cast an Innate Darkness spell, up to your Charisma modifier creatures can see through your magical Darkness for 1 minute.

features.name: Pure Darkness
features.description: Darkvision and Blindsight can't see into Darkness created by your Innate Darkness spells.

features.name: One with Darkness
features.description: On your turn you are Invisible, even to Truesight and Blindsight, and if you haven't moved you can teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see (then your Speed is 0 for the turn).

features.name: Feline Spells
features.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Cat's Spring, Feather Fall, Feline Grace, Misty Step, Speak with Animals; 5 Haste, Phantom Panther; 7 Freedom of Movement, Dimension Door; 9 Feline Chaos, Telekinesis.

features.name: Feline Affinity
features.description: Cast Speak with Animals without a slot, but only to talk with cats.

features.name: Feline Form
features.description: As a Bonus Action, become a Cat for hours equal to half your Warlock level, keeping your Hit Points, mental scores, class features, languages, feats, and proficiencies. You can cast only Feline Spells (without Material components), and casting a non-hostile spell while Hidden keeps you Invisible. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Vexing Distraction
features.description: In cat form, as a Bonus Action a creature within 5 feet that can see and hear you makes a Wisdom save or you choose: Annoy (Disadvantage on D20 Tests), Confound (Speed 0), or Distract (a creature you choose has Total Cover from it) until the end of your next turn. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Nine Lives
features.description: You have nine lives per Long Rest: spend 1 to avoid a death save failure from damage at 0 (2 for a critical), 1 to succeed on a death save, 5 to turn it into a 20, 1 to survive massive damage at 0, 1 to drop to 1 instead of 0, or 9 to ignore an instant-death effect.

features.name: Summon the Courtiers
features.description: When a creature within 60 feet damages you, take a Reaction: spectral cats deal it 5d10 Force and leave it Blinded and Prone until the end of your next turn. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a Pact Magic slot.

features.name: Book Learning
features.description: Touching a text for 1 minute grants a working knowledge of it unless coded. For a magic book or script, you learn its properties, attunement, charges, active spells, and the spell that made it.

features.name: Edit Spell
features.description: Choose a level 1+ spell in your spellbook; prepared versions can gain +1 save DC, a different damage type, and/or an Intelligence save instead of the normal one, and can be prepared multiple times with different edits (each counts as prepared). Change the choice after a Long Rest.

features.name: Weaver of Words
features.description: You learn all languages available in the campaign.

features.name: Customized Spell
features.description: Choose a level 1+ Concentration spell with a Verbal component and name a willing creature other than you when you prepare it; cast on that creature alone, it needs no Concentration.

features.name: Master of Words
features.description: When you prepare spells, link two level 1 to 5 one-action Verbal spells into one prepared spell of their combined level (maximum 6); casting it as a Magic action produces both effects.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: Proficiency with Smith's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you already have it). Crafting an ordinary or magic weapon takes half the time.

features.name: Forge Adept Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Armor of Agathys, Shield of Faith (3); Spiritual Weapon, Warding Bond (5); Beacon of Hope, Remove Curse (9); Death Ward, Fire Shield (13); Banishing Smite, Wall of Force (17).

features.name: Battle Ready
features.description: Use Intelligence for attack and damage rolls with magic weapons. Proficiency with Martial weapons, and you can use a weapon you're proficient with as your Artificer spellcasting focus.

features.name: Ghaal'Shaarat
features.description: As a Magic action with Smith's Tools in hand, imbue a Simple or Martial melee weapon with your spirit until you imbue another or die. While you wield it, it is magic with a +1 bonus to attack and damage, has the Thrown property (30/120), and returns to your hand after a ranged attack.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Runes of War
features.description: Your Ghaal'Shaarat bonus becomes +2. Aura of War: as a Magic action, a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute; you and allies in it deal an extra 1d4 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (your choice) on weapon or Unarmed Strike hits. Uses equal to your Intelligence modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Perfect Weapon
features.description: Your Ghaal'Shaarat bonus becomes +3, and on your first attack each turn you can shift some or all of it to your AC until your next turn. Hits deal an extra 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder (and can deal that type instead of the normal one). Resistance to Psychic, and immunity to Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Weapon of Legend (variant capstone)
features.description: With DM permission, replaces Soul of Artifice. While wielding your Ghaal'Shaarat: Aura of War is always active (Bonus Action to change its type); enemies starting their turn in it take its extra damage; as a Bonus Action raise the aura to 2d6 for 1 minute, Intelligence modifier times per Long Rest.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: Proficiency with Tinker's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you already have it). Crafting a magic item takes half the time.

features.name: Maverick Spells
features.description: Learn one cantrip from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard list. When you prepare spells, prepare extra spells equal to your Proficiency Bonus from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard lists; all count as Artificer spells.

features.name: Arcane Prototype
features.description: At the end of a Long Rest with Tinker's Tools, spend Arcane Charges (spell level each) to build prototypes holding spells from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard lists. Only you can cast from them, without a slot, preparation, or material components; a prototype crumbles after use unless you expend a slot of the spell's level. Prototypes/max level/charges: 1/1/1 at 3, 2/2/3 at 5, 3/3/5 at 9, 3/4/7 at 13, 4/5/9 at 15, 4/6/11 at 17, 5/6/13 at 20.

features.name: Fine Tuning
features.description: With Tinker's Tools on you, add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of an Artificer spell.

features.name: Work in Progress
features.description: After a Short Rest, swap one prepared spell for another from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard list.

features.name: Final Breakthrough
features.description: After a Short Rest, swap a prototype's spell for another of the same level from those lists. You ignore class, species, spell, and level requirements for attuning to or using magic items.

features.name: Improved Genius (variant capstone)
features.description: With DM permission, replaces Soul of Artifice. Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, cast any spell of level 8 or lower, ignoring its casting time, components, and requirements.

features.name: Broad Inspiration
features.description: Learn Guidance (doesn't count against cantrips). When you give Bardic Inspiration, you can give the same die to a second creature in range.

features.name: Keeper of History
features.description: Proficiency in History and Performance, or Expertise in either you already have.

features.name: Commanding Voice
features.description: When you take the Attack or Magic action, two creatures holding your Bardic Inspiration can spend it to use their Reaction for one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, adding the die to damage on a hit.

features.name: Battle Hymn
features.description: As a Bonus Action, sing until the start of your next turn (heard within 60 feet); allies within 30 feet who hear you add 1d4 to ability checks and saving throws.

features.name: Mind Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Command, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Spike (3); Clairvoyance, Fear (5); Confusion, Phantasmal Killer (7); Synaptic Static, Telekinesis (9).

features.name: Psychic Feedback
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet that you can see succeeds on a Wisdom save, use your Reaction and a Channel Divinity to impose Disadvantage on that save.

features.name: Psychic Force
features.description: Cleric spells that deal Radiant can deal Psychic instead, and spells that deal Psychic add your Charisma modifier to damage against one target.

features.name: Gestalt Anchor
features.description: You and allies in a 10-foot Emanation gain +2 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves (inactive while you're Incapacitated; only one Gestalt Anchor applies at a time).

features.name: Bend Reality
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when an ally within 30 feet that you can see fails a save, change the roll to a 20.

features.name: Skin of Steel
features.description: In Wild Shape: max CR equals Druid level / 3; AC is 15 + Wisdom modifier if higher; Resistance to Poison and Advantage on saves against Poisoned; no Exhaustion from hunger, thirst, or suffocation, no need to sleep, and immune to magical sleep. Your form is obviously warforged-like.

features.name: Circle of the Forged Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Blade Ward, Identify, Mirror Image (3); Haste (5); Fire Shield (7); Animate Objects (9).

features.name: Elementally Imbued
features.description: Wild Shape attacks can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning. Once per turn on a hit, expend a slot for +1d6 per slot level (max 5d6) of a chosen type; Constitution save or a 1-minute effect (save ends each turn): Acid lowers AC by half your Wisdom modifier, Cold sets Speed to 0 with Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks, Fire deals Wisdom-modifier damage each turn, Lightning blocks Opportunity Attacks and gives Disadvantage on its first attack each turn.

features.name: Adamantine Hide
features.description: In Wild Shape, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing. When hit by an attack or forced to save, use your Reaction and a Wild Shape use to shift into a form.

features.name: Construction Perfection
features.description: In Wild Shape, AC is 16 + Wisdom modifier if higher, and you are immune to Poison damage and to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned.

features.name: Martial Form
features.description: At the start of your turn, spend 1 Focus Point to adopt a form for 10 minutes: Forged Heart (Unarmed Strikes crit objects; Flurry hits force a Strength save or push 15 feet), Nightmare Shroud (Deflect Attacks forces a Wisdom save or the attacker is Frightened until the end of its next turn), Traveler's Blade (+10 feet reach), or Weretouched (dropping an adjacent enemy to 0 grants temp HP of a Martial Arts die + Monk level).

features.name: Mutable Strike
features.description: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage.

features.name: Manifest Blow
features.description: Gain one: Forged Heart (once per turn, +1 Martial Arts die damage), Nightmare Shroud (Magic action, 2 Focus Points: 30-foot Emanation, Wisdom save or 3 Martial Arts dice Psychic and Frightened, half on success), Traveler's Blade (once per turn deal damage and grapple on one hit; you always count as having a free hand to grapple), or Weretouched (hit the same creature twice in a turn to spend up to 3 Focus Points for that many extra Martial Arts dice).

features.name: Reflexive Adaptation
features.description: Self-Restoration can also end Blinded, Deafened, and Grappled. A Short Rest removes 1 Exhaustion level, a Long Rest removes all.

features.name: Perfect Form
features.description: When adopting your Martial Form, spend 3 more Focus Points to also gain Advantage on Flurry of Blows attacks, regain a Martial Arts die of HP at the start of each turn, and +2 AC while in the form.

features.name: Demontongue
features.description: You speak and understand Abyssal or Infernal (your choice).

features.name: Fiendish Punishment
features.description: While raging, once per turn when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you, it takes 1d4 Fire or Necrotic. When an ally within 10 feet is damaged by such a creature, use your Reaction to deal the same. Damage grows to 1d6 (6), 1d8 (10), 1d10 (14), 1d12 (20).

features.name: Just One Master
features.description: While raging, Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened and Resistance to Psychic. When you take Psychic damage or save against Charmed or Frightened, you must use your Reaction to Rage without expending a use.

features.name: Overflowing Malice
features.description: When a creature triggers Fiendish Punishment, all other creatures within 10 feet of you also take the damage.

features.name: Aspect of Tyranny
features.description: When Fiendish Punishment or Overflowing Malice deals damage, use your Reaction to force one affected creature to make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Con + PB, -1 per other creature affected that turn): on a failure, 1d10 Necrotic and Frightened for 1 minute (save ends each turn).

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: Learn one Sorcerer cantrip (it counts as a Bard cantrip but not against your known cantrips), and you can use a Wand, Rod, or Orb as your Bard focus.

features.name: Wandslinger's Presence
features.description: After talking with a creature for 1 minute, if it rolls Initiative equal to or higher than yours it makes a Wisdom save; on a failure its Initiative drops to act right after you.

features.name: At Your Fingertips
features.description: Once per round on your turn, when a Bard cantrip hits or a target fails its save, spend a Bardic Inspiration for +2d6 damage (3d6 at 5, 5d6 at 10, 8d6 at 15).

features.name: Got Your Back
features.description: When you use At Your Fingertips, use a Bonus Action that turn to give a creature within 60 feet Advantage on its next save within 1 minute.

features.name: Ain't Big Enough for the Both of Us
features.description: Whenever you spend Bardic Inspiration or a creature within 60 feet adds your die to a D20 Test, one creature within 60 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn; an already Frightened target must use its Reaction to flee.

features.name: Commerce Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Augury, Charm Person, Comprehend Languages, Locate Object (3); Glyph of Warding, Tongues (5); Divination, Leomund's Secret Chest (7); Legend Lore, Rary's Telepathic Bond (9).

features.name: Divine Wealth
features.description: After a Long Rest, conjure 2 divine coins (3 at 5, 4 at 9, 5 at 13, 6 at 17), losing unspent ones. Before a save against a hostile effect, spend a coin to add 1d4, or gain a coin by subtracting 1d4.

features.name: Money Spinner
features.description: Magic action and a Channel Divinity: target one creature within 30 feet plus one per coin spent. Each makes a Wisdom save; on a failure, Reward (Charmed and Friendly for 1 minute or until damaged) or Bribe (Blinded for 1 minute or until damaged), your choice per target.

features.name: Divine Bargain
features.description: As a Bonus Action with a creature within 30 feet: Buy (give it a coin; it takes 1d8 Necrotic and you or a creature within 30 feet heals that much; it can spend the coin) or Sell (gain a coin; you take unreducible 1d8 Necrotic and it heals that much).

features.name: Open Market
features.description: Divine Bargain uses 2d8, and you can bargain with up to six creatures at once using one roll, once per Short Rest.

features.name: Bloodhound Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Alarm (3), Hold Person (5), Clairvoyance (9), Locate Creature (13), Scrying (17).

features.name: Ley Line Tracker
features.description: After a rest, mark a creature you've seen (or whose possession you hold) as your bounty; once per turn switch it to a creature you can see. Your Ranger Divination spells can target your bounty at any distance on the same plane unless it's warded.

features.name: Unwavering Attention
features.description: Once per turn, +1d6 damage when you hit your bounty or your Hunter's Mark target. If dealt with an Opportunity Attack, your Reaction returns at the start of the next creature's turn.

features.name: Relentless Pursuit
features.description: When your bounty or Hunter's Mark target ends its turn more than 5 feet away and you can see it, use your Reaction to move your Speed toward it without provoking.

features.name: Eyes on the Prize
features.description: When all your Attack-action attacks target one creature, make one extra attack; a melee hit leaves it Grappled or Prone, a ranged hit knocks it Prone.

features.name: Nowhere to Hide
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, cast True Seeing on yourself without a slot or components. Ley Line Tracker ignores magic that hides your bounty from Divination.

features.name: Nemesis Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Compelled Duel, Mirror Image, See Invisibility, Shield (3); Counterspell, Slow (5); Fire Shield, Otiluke's Resilient Sphere (7); Circle of Power, Mislead (9).

features.name: Readied Magic
features.description: When you Ready a spell, you have Advantage on saves and ability checks until your next turn and can cast it without your Reaction. If you don't release it, regain Sorcery Points equal to its level at the start of your next turn.

features.name: Spell Deflection
features.description: When a spell or magical effect damages you, use your Reaction to halve that damage.

features.name: Always Ready
features.description: Ready a spell as a Bonus Action (it doesn't count toward the one-slot-per-turn limit). Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend 4 Sorcery Points to restore it.

features.name: Mindset of Perfect Prediction
features.description: Once per Long Rest when you roll Initiative: your Initiative becomes 31, you can concentrate on any number of spells (one save for all), and you can cast Counterspell as a level 6 spell without a slot. At the end of each of your turns, make a Charisma save (DC 8 + Cha + PB) or the mindset ends, keeping one concentration spell.

features.name: Eternity in Stone
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you can Petrify it and gain 1d10 + Warlock level Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Stone Speaker
features.description: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, question stones in a 30-foot Emanation about the past day, and speak with earth Elementals or Petrified creatures there.

features.name: Stone Sovereign Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Absorb Elements, Earthbind, Earth Tremor, Spike Growth (3); Magic Circle, Slow (5); Stone Shape, Stoneskin (7); Bigby's Hand, Wall of Stone (9).

features.name: Form of Stone
features.description: While Petrified you stay aware and are immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing. Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Reaction to damage, Petrify yourself until your next turn (before the damage), then emerge from stone up to 30 feet away.

features.name: Stone's Embrace
features.description: Meld into Stone is always prepared and can include up to five willing creatures within 5 feet. Resting while melded grants Resistance to the first damage after leaving.

features.name: Stone Servant
features.description: Touch a Petrified creature to make it an Earth Elemental Spirit under your control as a level 6 Summon Elemental, without Concentration, until Greater Restoration, 0 HP, or you use this again.

features.name: Ranged Specialist
features.description: Training with all ranged weapons (including thrown weapons and firearms), and no Disadvantage on ranged attacks for an enemy within 5 feet.

features.name: Game Hunter
features.description: After a Long Rest pick Large, Huge, or Gargantuan: ranged hits deal +1d8 Piercing against that size and +1d4 against the other two, up to twice per turn.

features.name: Bolas
features.description: After a Long Rest make bolas ammunition equal to your Wisdom modifier (damage optional). A hit forces a Strength or Dexterity save (DC 8 + Wis + PB) or the target is Grappled. Leftovers become normal ammunition.

features.name: Special Shots
features.description: Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, before a ranged attack roll: Drill Shot (+5 to hit), Trick Shot (measure line of sight and range from a point within 60 feet), or Power Shot (weapon damage and crit dice are maximized).

features.name: Improved Bolas
features.description: Make bolas equal to Wisdom + Dexterity modifiers, and double your Proficiency Bonus in their DC.

features.name: Reliable Aim
features.description: Once per turn, reroll a missed ranged weapon attack, Dexterity modifier times per Long Rest (minimum once).

features.name: Improved Special Shots
features.description: Special Shots uses become twice your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Apex Hunter
features.description: Hunter's Mark lasts 48 hours, and while it's on a living enemy you need no sleep and ignore malnutrition and dehydration.

features.name: Predator's Intuition
features.description: When Bolas or a Special Shot hits a Large or bigger creature, you learn its remaining Hit Points.

features.name: Finish the Hunt
features.description: Once per Long Rest as an Action, with a one-liner, a ranged attack automatically hits a visible Large or bigger creature within 60 feet: it dies if it has 100 HP or fewer, otherwise takes 10d10 + 30 Piercing.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Intelligence-based. Cantrips: Poison Spray, Mending, Spare the Dying. Slots usable only for Bonesmith spells (as an Eldritch Knight-style third caster, up to level 4 slots at 19). Always prepared: Inflict Wounds, False Life, Find Familiar (3); Ray of Enfeeblement, Alter Self, Protection from Poison (7); Speak with Dead, Animate Dead, Fear (13); Blight, Fabricate, Death Ward (19). Focus: Smith's or Leatherworker's Tools or a weapon you crafted.

features.name: Body Knowledge
features.description: Use Intelligence for attack and damage rolls with weapons you crafted with Melder of Flesh and Bone.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.description: Harvest hide, bone, horn, and fangs from fresh carcasses (more and slower for bigger creatures; two helpers halve the time).

features.name: Melder of Flesh and Bone
features.description: Proficiency with Leatherworker's Tools, Smith's Tools, and Medicine. Over a Long Rest, craft armor, shields, weapons, and trinkets from harvested parts.

features.name: Improved Crafting
features.description: Your crafted items are +1.

features.name: Construct of Flesh
features.description: Over a Long Rest, build a Medium Undead companion (AC 15, HP 5 + 5 per Fighter level, Str 18, Dex 16) with one trait (Arboreal, Volant, Nocturnal, Robust, or Nimble) and one attack (+4 + PB, 1d10 + PB plus 1d6 Necrotic, with a rider: poison, prone, acid range, or fear). It acts after you and only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command it.

features.name: Artisan Crafter
features.description: Your crafted items are +2.

features.name: Improved Construct of Flesh
features.description: Add a second trait, and you can forgo attacks of your Attack action to let the construct attack.

features.name: Body Modification
features.description: Over a Long Rest, fuse up to three crafted items (one armor or up to two weapons per rest) into your body; draw or conceal weapons as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Master Crafter
features.description: Your crafted items are +3.

features.name: Combat Bonesmithing
features.description: During the Attack action, spend 10 harvested resources (rising by 10 each use until a Long Rest) to replace one attack with a one-Action Bonesmith spell.

features.name: Minion Master
features.description: Construct gets +2 AC, a second attack, and +2d6 Necrotic on its attacks; once per Long Rest it drops to 1 HP instead of 0.

features.name: Flesh from Shadow
features.description: Once per Long Rest cast Creation without a slot, optionally making a harvestable beast carcass up to Large that lasts 24 hours (its products last a week).

features.name: Circle of Cycles Spells
features.description: Always prepared: Augury, Evolution/Devolution (3); Clairvoyance, Tongues, Meld into Stone (5); Legend Lore, Contact Other Plane (9); Find the Path, Contingency, Flesh to Stone, Circle of Death (13); Foresight, Glibness, Time Stop (17).

features.name: Adaptive Wild Shape
features.description: Each Wild Shape adds one: +30 climb (or +20), +15 fly (or +10; DM may limit to Tiny and Small until level 8), water breathing and +30 swim (or +20), Darkvision 60 (or +30), or one attack dealing Acid or Poison.

features.name: Glimpse Future
features.description: Advantage on Dexterity saves, and use your Reaction to give an ally you can see Advantage on a Dexterity save if they can hear you.

features.name: Improved Evolution/Devolution
features.description: Evolution/Devolution gains 30-foot range and Bonus Action casting; harmful changes also deal 1d8 + Wisdom Necrotic (half on a save). Cast it once per Long Rest at level 2 without a slot.

features.name: Deep Hibernation
features.description: Hibernate for 24+ hours without aging or needs, waking with a Long Rest and a chosen apparent age; commune with the past or a possible future for lore.

features.name: Improved Glimpse Future
features.description: Evasion on Dexterity saves, and use your Reaction to grant it to an ally who can hear you.

features.name: Cosmological Evolution
features.description: Once per Long Rest as an Action: darkness or daylight over 10 miles for 10 minutes, or for 1 minute you and allies within 15 feet reroll one missed melee attack, missed ranged attack, or failed save per turn (your pick).

features.name: Guided Evolution
features.description: Concentrate on Evolution/Devolution for 10 minutes to make it last until recast or the target's next Long Rest.

features.name: Future Sight
features.description: Once per Long Rest as an Action, for 1 hour you have Advantage on attacks and attacks against you have Disadvantage (not while Incapacitated or Blinded).

features.name: Equipped for Battle
features.description: You become trained with Heavy armor.

features.name: Close Quarters
features.description: After you hit a creature with a Melee weapon attack roll, you can take a Reaction to add 2d6 damage of the weapon's type; the target then has Disadvantage on its next attack roll made before the start of your next turn. The extra damage rises to 4d6 at Monster Hunter level 11.

features.name: True Grit
features.description: Saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition have Advantage, and creature types in your Monster Grimoire can't give you the Frightened condition at all. Also, whenever an attack you make as part of a Reaction hits, you can end the Frightened condition on yourself or on one creature within 60 feet that can see you.

features.name: Terrorize the Terrors
features.description: Whenever an attack you make as part of a Reaction hits a creature, you can make it succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Intelligence modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Deadly Redirect
features.description: Close Quarters now deals 6d6 extra damage, and a creature you damage with it has Disadvantage on every attack roll it makes until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Controlled Footwork
features.description: You can take two Reactions per round rather than one.

features.name: Alchemical Gastronomy
features.description: You gain proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies and Cook's Utensils.

features.name: Transmuting Metabolism
features.description: Salvaging: as a Utilize action, harvest one portion from a creature's physical remains (one portion per creature), noting its creature type; the portion spoils when you finish a Long Rest. Consuming: as a Bonus Action, eat a portion and pick a mutation allowed by that creature's type (see Mutations). You can benefit from portions a number of times equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1), regained on a Long Rest; several mutations can be active at once, but never two copies of the same one.

features.name: Mutations
features.description: Acid Blood (Aberration, Ooze, Plant): for 1 minute, a creature within 5 feet that hits you with an attack takes 2d6 Acid damage. Acumen (Celestial, Fiend, Fey): for 1 hour, Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks plus Advantage on checks with your choice of Intimidation or Persuasion. Awareness (All): for 10 minutes, you know where creatures of the eaten creature's type are within 60 feet unless they have Total Cover. Flight (Celestial, Dragon, Elemental): for 10 minutes, Fly Speed equal to your Speed; doesn't work while you wear Heavy armor. Infused (Dragon, Elemental, Ooze): for 10 minutes, your hits can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage (chosen on eating) in place of their normal type. Invisibility (Fey, Fiend, Undead): for 10 minutes, you have the Invisible condition, ending early if you attack, cast a spell, or dismiss it (no action). Might (Beast, Construct, Giant): for 1 minute, Advantage on Strength checks, Strength saving throws, and Strength-based attack rolls, and those attacks deal 1d6 extra damage of the attack's type. Natural Weapons (Beast, Dragon, Monstrosity): for 1 hour, your Unarmed Strikes can deal 1d6 Piercing or Slashing damage (chosen per attack), can use Dexterity in place of Strength, and you can make one as a Bonus Action. Regeneration (Beast, Giant, Monstrosity): regain 2d8 + your Monster Hunter level Hit Points. Resistance (Construct, Elemental, Undead): for 1 minute, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. Telepathy (Aberration, Fiend, Plant): for 1 hour, you can speak telepathically in a language you know to any creature you see within 60 feet (it understands only if it knows that language), and you have Resistance to Psychic damage.

features.name: Synchronized Response
features.description: Eating a monster portion also gives you, for 1 minute, an extra 1d6 damage (of the weapon's or Unarmed Strike's type) on attacks you make as part of a Reaction.

features.name: Gnawing Hunger
features.description: When you deal damage with a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, you can gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage, or equal to the full damage if the target's type is in your Monster Grimoire. Usable a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1), regained on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Alchemical Decoctions
features.description: With Alchemist's Supplies, 1 hour, and 20 GP of alchemical ingredients, you turn a monster portion into a decoction, a magic potion granting that portion's benefits. Up to 4 unconsumed decoctions can exist at once, and you can destroy one as a Utilize action. Another creature can safely drink 1 decoction, but each further decoction it drinks before finishing a Long Rest gives it 1 Exhaustion level.

features.name: Acquired Taste
features.description: You can safely consume 1 more portion than before, and for 1 minute after eating a portion you have Advantage on attack rolls made as part of a Reaction.

features.name: Acolyte of the Occult
features.description: You gain proficiency in Arcana.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Wizard spells using Intelligence, with an Arcane Focus as your Spellcasting Focus, and regain all slots on a Long Rest. Cantrips: two Wizard cantrips (a third at Monster Hunter level 10); swap one when you gain a Monster Hunter level. Prepared spells are Wizard spells of levels you have slots for (Burning Hands, Detect Magic, and Protection from Evil and Good are suggested at the start), and you may swap one per Monster Hunter level gained. Table by Monster Hunter level (prepared spells; slots 1st/2nd/3rd/4th): 3: 3; 2. 4 to 6: 4; 3. 7: 5; 4/2. 8 and 9: 6; 4/2. 10: 7; 4/3. 11 and 12: 8; 4/3. 13: 9; 4/3/2. 14 and 15: 10; 4/3/2. 16: 11; 4/3/2. 17 and 18: 11; 4/3/3. 19: 12; 4/3/3/1. 20: 13; 4/3/3/1.

features.name: Arcane Interference
features.description: Spells cast by creature types in your Monster Grimoire give you Advantage on your saving throws against them. Also, when a creature you can see within 60 feet casts a spell or makes a spell attack, you can trigger Studied Response against it before the spell happens.

features.name: Mage Hunter
features.description: Spellcasting Humanoids count as a creature type in your Monster Grimoire. When you damage a Grimoire creature that is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on the Concentration save.

features.name: Occult Knowledge
features.description: You can cast any prepared spell with the Ritual tag as a Ritual. You also learn two Ritual-tagged spells from any mix of the Cleric, Druid, and Wizard lists; at Monster Hunter level 14 you can swap one of them for a Ritual-tagged spell from any list.

features.name: Magical Aegis
features.description: You project an invisible 20-foot Emanation (suppressed while you have the Incapacitated condition) in which you and your allies have Advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creature types in your Monster Grimoire. Counterspell is always prepared for you, and you can cast it once without a slot, regaining that use on a Long Rest.

features.name: Arcane Response
features.description: Whenever you use Studied Response, you can also cast a spell with a casting time of an action that targets only the triggering creature.

features.name: Sneaky and Crafty
features.description: You gain proficiency in Stealth and with Tinker's Tools.

features.name: Trapper Gadgets
features.description: During a Long Rest you can build two gadgets if you have materials and Tinker's Tools, and at other times you can build one with 1 hour of work and 20 GP of materials. Gadget save DC = 8 + your Intelligence modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. Dread Venom: oil for one Slashing or Piercing weapon or up to 10 such pieces of ammunition (1 minute to apply, lasts 8 hours); a creature damaged by it can't regain Hit Points until it finishes a Short or Long Rest. Elemental Ammunition: as a Bonus Action, imbue one piece of Longbow, Shortbow, or Crossbow ammunition with Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder; a creature it damages takes 2d6 extra damage of that type; it's spent on a hit, reusable on a miss, and holds its charge 48 hours. Runic Bomb (single use): as a Bonus Action, throw it at a point you see within 60 feet to make a 20-foot-radius Sphere that spreads around corners, is Lightly Obscured, and lasts 1 minute or until strong wind disperses it; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt to creatures inside becomes Force damage. Scorpion Anchor: fired from a Longbow, Shortbow, or Crossbow during an Attack action; on a hit the target has the Restrained condition, and it can take an action for a Strength (Athletics) check against your gadget DC to escape; destroyed when the target escapes or dies.

features.name: Trapper Gadgets (continued)
features.description: Terrain Cloak: worn over Light or Medium armor (donned and doffed like Light armor); creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to see you; falls apart when you finish a Long Rest. Weretrap: as a Utilize action, place it in an unoccupied space within 5 feet; creatures within 30 feet need a Wisdom (Perception) check against your gadget DC, made with Disadvantage, to notice it. A creature entering its space makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 Bludgeoning damage and the Prone condition on a failure, or half damage only on a success. It can instead be thrown as a Light, Finesse, Thrown ranged weapon (range 20/60 feet) dealing 3d10 Bludgeoning damage and the Prone condition on a hit. It is destroyed once triggered or thrown.

features.name: Ambusher's Advantage
features.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to Initiative rolls. Enemies that include creature types in your Monster Grimoire can't surprise you.

features.name: Agile Response
features.description: When a creature makes a melee attack roll against you, you can take a Reaction to give that roll Disadvantage and use Studied Response as part of the same Reaction. Hit or miss, you can then move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Monster-Hide Armor
features.description: You can craft Light or Medium armor (your choice) from monster parts; it works as that armor type and carries two modifications, and you can swap one each time you gain a Monster Hunter level. Modifications work only while it is worn. Options: Damage Resistance (Resistance to two of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder); Elemental Charge (pick one of those types; your hits can deal that type instead of their normal type plus 1d6 extra of it); Hardened Defense (+2 AC); Phase Leap (Bonus Action teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you see, 3 uses per Long Rest); Regeneration (a pool of six d10s; as a Bonus Action spend one and heal its roll + your Constitution modifier, pool refills on a Long Rest); Stealthy (no Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks from the armor, creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to see you, and you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice creatures).

features.name: Rapid Tinkerer
features.description: Twice per Long Rest, you can build a Trapper Gadget in 1 minute with no GP or components.

features.name: Eagle Eye
features.description: Maneuver. Once per turn when a ranged attack roll misses, spend 1 Risk Die and add it to the roll, which may turn the miss into a hit.

features.name: Sharpshooter's Stance
features.description: Being Prone doesn't give you Disadvantage on ranged attack rolls, and standing up from Prone costs you only 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Concealed Position
features.description: While Prone you can take the Hide action without being Heavily Obscured or behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover; the resulting Invisible condition ends if you stop being Prone. A missed attack roll made while hidden doesn't give away your location.

features.name: Reposition
features.description: Reaction when a creature misses you with an attack roll: stop being Prone and move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Focused Shot
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can make just one ranged weapon attack as a Focused Shot; it has Advantage, and a hit is a Critical Hit.

features.name: Poker Face
features.description: Gain proficiency with all Gaming Sets and with one skill of your choice: Deception, Insight or Perception.

features.name: Liar's Dice
features.description: Maneuver. When you roll damage with a Ranged weapon, spend 1 Risk Die as a Bonus Action to roll in secret and announce any total. If the GM calls the bluff and you lied, the damage is halved; if you told the truth, it is doubled; if the GM doesn't call it, your announced total stands.

features.name: Risky Business
features.description: Once per turn, when you make an attack roll against an enemy that doesn't already have Disadvantage, you may impose Disadvantage on it to regain one spent Risk Die.

features.name: Risk Taker
features.description: Maverick Spirit and Skin of Your Teeth no longer cost a Risk Die for you; when used this way, roll a d6 in place of the Risk Die.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.description: After scoring a Critical Hit with a Ranged weapon, you may roll a d20: on 10 or higher roll the attack's damage dice four times in total instead of twice, but on 9 or lower the Critical Hit becomes an ordinary hit.

features.name: Operative Training
features.description: You learn the Concealed Shot cantrip (choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma as its spellcasting ability when you take this subclass); it makes a touched Ranged weapon silent and its shots invisible in flight for 1 minute, and a hidden attack against a target 80 or more feet away doesn't reveal you. You also gain a Disguise Kit and Thieves' Tools with proficiency in both, plus proficiency in two of Deception, Investigation, Persuasion, Sleight of Hand or Stealth.

features.name: Parting Shot
features.description: Maneuver. After taking the Dash, Disengage or Dodge action on your turn, spend 1 Risk Die to make a ranged weapon attack as a Bonus Action, adding the die to its damage on a hit.

features.name: Fieldcraft
features.description: With a Disguise Kit you can create and put on a Costume as a Bonus Action. On Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks, any d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

features.name: Exit Strategy
features.description: Reaction when you take damage: become Invisible until the start of your next turn and move up to 10 feet right away. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it by spending 1 Risk Die (no action).

features.name: License to Kill
features.description: When you deal Ranged weapon damage, spend one or two Risk Dice and add them to the damage. Any die that rolls its maximum is rolled again and added without being spent, repeating on further maximums; the total number of Risk Dice added this way can't exceed your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Intelligence-based Wizard spellcasting, using an Arcane Focus or a Ranged weapon as your focus. You know two Wizard cantrips (three at Gunslinger level 10) and may swap one per level gained. Prepared spells rise from 3 at level 3 to 13 at level 20, chosen from the Wizard list at levels you have slots for, with one swap per level gained.
