Slots return on a Long Rest and top out at level 4 slots (see the Spellslinger Spellcasting table: level 1 slots 2 at level 3, 3 at 4, 4 from 7; level 2 slots 2 at 7, 3 from 10; level 3 slots 2 at 13, 3 from 16; one level 4 slot at 19).

features.name: Bang, You're Dead!
features.description: You learn the Finger Guns cantrip: as a Bonus Action your hand becomes a Simple Ranged weapon for 1 minute (range 60/240, rising to 90/360, 120/480 and 150/600 at character levels 5, 11 and 17; Slow mastery) that can attack with your spellcasting ability and deals 2d6 Force damage with no ability modifier. When a Finger Guns attack hits, you can spend 1 Risk Die as a Bonus Action to add it to the damage.

features.name: Spellshot
features.description: When you take the Attack action, one of the attacks can be swapped for casting a Wizard cantrip with a casting time of an action.

features.name: Counter-Mage
features.description: Your ranged attack rolls suppress, for that attack, spells affecting the target (such as Mage Armor) and the properties of magic items it wears or carries, and the target can't use a Reaction to cast spells like Shield against the attack or its damage. While a Gut Shot projectile from your Critical Hit is lodged, the target can't cast spells or take the Magic action and has Disadvantage on Concentration saves. When you fail a save against a spell or magical effect, you can use your Reaction to add 1d6 to it.

features.name: Magic Bullet
features.description: Maneuver. When you make a spell attack roll, spend 1 Risk Die as a Bonus Action to make it a ranged weapon attack instead, adding the die to the attack roll; a hit deals the weapon's normal damage on top of the spell attack's effects.

features.name: Creative Trajectory
features.description: Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover don't apply against your ranged weapon attacks.

features.name: Ricochet
features.description: Maneuver. When a ranged weapon attack misses, take a Bonus Action and spend 1 Risk Die to reroll the attack, adding the die; the new roll must be used.

features.name: Fancy Gunplay
features.description: Once per turn on a Charisma (Performance) or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check made with one of your Ranged weapons, roll a Risk Die and add it without spending it. On your turn you can reload a weapon with the Reload property without using an action or Bonus Action.

features.name: Deft Deflection
features.description: Maneuver. While holding a Ranged weapon, when an ally within 30 feet is hit by an attack, use your Reaction and spend 1 Risk Die to give that ally the Skin of Your Teeth benefit against the attack.

features.name: Pinball Shot
features.description: Once on each of your turns after hitting with a ranged weapon attack, make an attack roll against a different creature within 30 feet of the first; each hit lets you continue to another new target within 30 feet, until you miss or have made five attacks in total, never hitting the same creature twice per use. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it by spending two Risk Dice (no action).

features.name: Lay Down the Law
features.description: Maneuver. Bonus Action, spend 1 Risk Die: an ally you can see within 60 feet gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the roll, and until the start of your next turn you can use your Reaction to make a ranged weapon attack against any creature that hits that ally with an attack.

features.name: Steely-Eyed Aura
features.description: You project a 10-foot Emanation in which you and your allies have Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Frightened condition. It is inactive while you are Incapacitated.

features.name: Reach for the Skies
features.description: When you score a Critical Hit, you can demand surrender instead of lodging a projectile: the target must succeed on a Wisdom save against your maneuver save DC or be Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, and the effect also ends if it takes damage or if you are Incapacitated or die.

features.name: Long Arm of the Law
features.description: Once per turn when a ranged weapon attack hits a Large or smaller creature, you can hobble it: on its next turn it can't move unless it takes the Disengage action first.

features.name: Gold Star Hero
features.description: Steely-Eyed Aura extends to 30 feet. Allies targeted by Lay Down the Law also gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage until the start of your next turn. Creatures that fail the Reach for the Skies save are Stunned rather than Incapacitated.

features.name: Amethyst Mark
features.description: Adds to your Mystic Mark. Aegis: Reaction when a willing creature you can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack, teleport to trade places with it; you take the attack instead, with Resistance to its damage. Enspell: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, the target makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC or is teleported 10 feet horizontally in a direction you pick.

features.name: Arcane Order Magic
features.description: An Arcane Focus works as your Magus Spellcasting Focus. Always prepared at Magus levels: 3 Demiplanar Pitch, Shocking Grasp, Find Familiar, Magic Missile; 5 Arcanist's Magic Aura, Misty Step; 9 Dispel Magic, Waypoint; 13 Banishment, Private Sanctum; 17 Reflect Magic, Teleportation Circle.

features.name: Mystic Insights
features.description: Learn two Wizard cantrips that count as Magus cantrips but not against your cantrips known. Gain Arcana proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient. Bonus Action: cast Detect Magic or Identify, a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Lesser Spell Surge
features.description: Once per Long Rest, cast a prepared Magus spell without a slot, treating it as cast with your highest-level slot.

features.name: Occult Savant
features.description: Pick two Wizard spells of levels you can cast; they are always prepared for you. Each time you gain a Magus level you may replace one with another Wizard spell of a castable level.

features.name: Arcane Vortex
features.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action warp a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you can see within 60 feet. You and allies inside may each teleport up to 30 feet in a direction you choose. Every other creature inside makes a Strength save against your spell save DC: on a failure it takes 6d8 Force damage, is pulled up to 15 feet toward the point, and can't use its Speed to move away from it until the start of your next turn; on a success, half damage only.

features.name: Master of the Arcane
features.description: Your Spell Surge use can instead cast Chain Lightning or Contingency. Once per Long Rest, finishing a Short Rest restores your use of Arcane Vortex.

features.name: Alabaster Mark
features.description: Adds to your Mystic Mark. Aegis: Reaction when a willing creature you can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack, guard it until the start of your next turn so attacks against it have Disadvantage. Enspell: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, the target has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Heaven's Guard Magic
features.description: A Holy Symbol works as your Magus Spellcasting Focus. Always prepared at Magus levels: 3 Cure Wounds, Give Life, Guiding Bolt, Righteous Incitement; 5 Animate Shield, Gentle Repose; 9 Mass Healing Word, Revivify; 13 Death Ward, Stoneskin; 17 Mass Cure Wounds, Raise Dead.

features.name: Heavensent
features.description: Best Offense: +2 to weapon and Unarmed Strike damage rolls while you use a Shield. Gifted Healer: when a spell or Magus feature of yours restores Hit Points, you may spend and roll a Hit Die and add it to the healing. Heaven's Hand: your damaging Magus spells can deal Radiant damage in place of their usual type.

features.name: Guardian's Wings
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Bonus Action fly up to twice your Speed; at the end of that turn, creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you regain Hit Points equal to your Magus level plus your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Cloak of Radiance
features.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action wrap a creature you can see within 30 feet in light, granting it 5d10 + your Magus level Temporary Hit Points. While any of those remain: attackers without Immunity to Blinded have Disadvantage against it; it sheds Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light 30 feet beyond; and it can Fly up to 30 feet as a Bonus Action each turn, drifting harmlessly to the ground if it ends that movement airborne.

features.name: Bright as Dawn
features.description: Your Spell Surge use can instead cast Heal or Sunbeam. Once per Long Rest, finishing a Short Rest restores your use of Cloak of Radiance.

features.name: Doombringer
features.description: Deathsight: you know when creatures you can see are Bloodied, and you can see Bloodied Invisible creatures and ignore the Disadvantage their invisibility would impose on your attacks. Unnatural Vitality: Bonus Action, spend a spell slot to regain expended Hit Dice equal to twice the slot's level. Reaper's Reward: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend and roll a Hit Die; you regain that many Hit Points and the target takes that much extra Necrotic damage.

features.name: Knights Stygian Magic
features.description: A Memento Mori works as your Magus Spellcasting Focus. Always prepared at Magus levels: 3 Bitter Wind, Hateful Haunting, Grave Bolt, Grave Grasp; 5 Carrionette, Web; 9 Animate Dead, Mortal Terror; 13 Black Tentacles, Stygian Blast; 17 Contagion, Insect Plague.

features.name: Obsidian Mark
features.description: Adds to your Mystic Mark. Aegis: Reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the attacker makes a Constitution save or takes Necrotic damage equal to half its attack's damage. Enspell: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, deal an extra 1d4 Necrotic damage, or 2d4 if the target is Bloodied.

features.name: Face of Fear
features.description: Dreadful Incantation: when you cast a level 1+ Necromancy spell or a Knights Stygian Magic spell, one creature within 60 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is Frightened until the start of your next turn. Fearless: Immunity to Frightened. Mortal Terror: Necrotic damage from your Magus spells and features can be dealt as Psychic instead.

features.name: Open the Iron Gates
features.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action create a 30-foot Emanation around you for 1 minute. A creature starting its turn inside can take 1d6 Necrotic damage, or 3d6 if Bloodied. As a Bonus Action you can make a Bloodied creature of your choice inside make a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or be Frightened until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Darkest Knight
features.description: Your Spell Surge use can instead cast Circle of Death or Create Undead. Once per Long Rest, finishing a Short Rest restores your use of Open the Iron Gates.

features.name: Hand and Foot Training
features.description: Covert Warrior: proficiency in Stealth (Expertise if already proficient) and Thieves' Tools. Enshadowed Equipment: Bonus Action, conjure one item into your hands from Caltrops, Costume, Crowbar, Grappling Hook, Ladder, Net, Parchment, Rope, Signal Whistle, Spyglass, or Thieves' Tools; it lasts until it spends 10 minutes in Bright Light, you dismiss it (no action), or you use this again; uses equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest. Martial Artist: Unarmed Strikes can use Dexterity for attack and damage and deal 1d6 in place of normal damage, and Dexterity can set the DC of your Grapple and Shove.

features.name: Jade Mark
features.description: Adds to your Mystic Mark. Aegis: Reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack, it becomes Invisible until the end of its next turn, ending early if it attacks, deals damage, or casts a spell. Enspell: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, the target is overexposed until the start of your next turn or until it takes a Critical Hit; attacks against an overexposed target crit on a 19 or 20.

features.name: Shadow Court Magic
features.description: Parchment works as your Magus Spellcasting Focus, but it is consumed when used for a level 1+ spell. Always prepared at Magus levels: 3 Disguise Self, Forced Hesitation, Phantasmal Feint, Obscuring Prick; 5 Darkness, Invisibility; 9 Hypnotic Pattern, Major Image; 13 Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer; 17 Mislead, Seeming.

features.name: Broken Mirror Jutsu
features.description: Mirror Image is always prepared. As a Bonus Action you can cast it with no slot; whenever one of these duplicates is destroyed, the attacker makes an Intelligence save against your Magus spell save DC or takes Psychic damage equal to your Magus level plus your Intelligence modifier. Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by spending a level 2+ slot (no action).

features.name: False Body Jutsu
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when an attack hits you, use your Reaction to cut its damage to 1, then teleport to an unoccupied space within 300 feet and become Invisible for 1 minute, leaving a harmless mundane object behind.

features.name: Enshadowed Sifu
features.description: Your Spell Surge use can instead cast Eyebite or Programmed Illusion. Once per Long Rest, finishing a Short Rest restores your use of False Body Jutsu.

features.name: Selenite Mark
features.description: Adds to your Mystic Mark. Aegis: Reaction when a willing creature you can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the attacker must reroll with Disadvantage and use the new roll. Enspell: once per turn when you miss with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, reroll the attack with Advantage and use the new roll.

features.name: Sidereal Cabal Magic
features.description: An Astrolabe or Arcane Focus works as your Magus Spellcasting Focus. Always prepared at Magus levels: 3 Misfortunate Missile, Overexposure, Bane, Bless; 5 Augury, Mind Spike; 9 Haste, Slow; 13 Cascade of Hours, Divination; 17 Dream, Scrying.

features.name: Starlit Sight
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 feet to existing Darkvision. Mini-Portent: after each Long Rest roll a d20 and record it; once, before a D20 Test by you or a creature you can see is rolled, you can substitute that number; an unused roll is lost at your next Long Rest. Gain Perception proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient.

features.name: Celestial Clockwork Control
features.description: After a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a D20 Test, spend a spell slot to raise or lower the result by the slot's level, which can flip success and failure. Usable once per round (recharges at the start of your next turn).

features.name: Seal Fate
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when a creature you can see within 60 feet rolls with Advantage or Disadvantage, it rolls three d20s instead of two, keeping the highest with Advantage or the lowest with Disadvantage.

features.name: Starfinder
features.description: Your Spell Surge use can instead cast First Speech or True Seeing. Seal Fate gains three uses, one returning on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Agrestal Spirit
features.description: Learn two extra Magus or Druid cantrips that count as Magus cantrips but not against your cantrips known. Gain Nature proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient. Wild Instincts: Disengage as a Bonus Action, and until your turn ends gain +15 feet Speed and Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks; uses equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Emerald Mark
features.description: Adds to your Mystic Mark. Aegis: Reaction when you or a willing creature you can see within 30 feet fails a save, add your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to it, possibly turning it into a success. Enspell: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, every space counts as Difficult Terrain for the target until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Sylvan Circle Spells
features.description: A Druidic Focus works as your Magus Spellcasting Focus. Always prepared at Magus levels: 3 Entangle, Speak with Animals, Thorn Whip, Thornhold; 5 Lesser Restoration, Moonbeam; 9 Conjure Animals, Speak with Plants; 13 Conjure Woodland Beings, Polymorph; 17 Greater Restoration, Reincarnate.

features.name: Nature's Mask
features.description: Polymorph is always prepared. Once per Short or Long Rest you can cast it on yourself with no slot; cast this way it needs no Concentration, lasts 8 hours, and you can end it at any time (no action).

features.name: Font of Life
features.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action project a 15-foot Emanation for 1 minute (ends early if you dismiss it, no action, or are Incapacitated). When it appears and at the start of each of your later turns, chosen creatures inside regain 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier Hit Points (minimum 1), and chosen creatures inside have Advantage on saving throws.

features.name: Sylvan Savant
features.description: Your Spell Surge use can instead cast Conjure Fey or Wall of Thorns. Once per Long Rest, finishing a Short Rest restores your use of Font of Life.

features.name: Brawler's Best Friend
features.description: You bond with a dog that uses the Hound stat block: Medium Beast, AC 12 + your CON mod, HP 5 + 5 times your Pugilist level (Pugilist level d8 Hit Dice), Speed 40 ft., STR 14 DEX 14 CON 15 INT 3 WIS 12 CHA 13, Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 11, understands your languages, adds your Proficiency Bonus to its ability checks and saves. Bite: to-hit equals your CON mod + PB, reach 5 ft., 2d4 + 2 + your CON mod Piercing; a Large or smaller target must pass a Strength save (DC 8 + your CON mod + PB) or you pick Grappled, Prone, or pushed 5 feet. It is Friendly, obeys you, flees if you die, and acts on your turn: it moves and reacts freely but only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command another action or give up one of your Attack action attacks to have it Bite; if you are Incapacitated it acts freely. If it died within the last hour, a Magic action touch and 2 Moxie Points revive it at full HP after 1 minute; after a Long Rest you can bond a new dog within 5 feet, replacing the old one.

features.name: Mutt With Moxie
features.description: Your Moxie options also aid the hound: Brace Up gives it the same Temporary Hit Points you gain; One-Two Punch lets it make either or both strikes in your place; Stick and Move lets it take the Dash, Disengage, or Help action (your pick).

features.name: Coordinated Attack
features.description: When you attack a creature within 5 feet of your hound, the hound can use its Reaction to grant Advantage; if that attack hits, it deals an extra 3d4 damage. The hound's damaging attack hits can deal Force or their normal type.

features.name: Hound's Best Friend
features.description: Reaction when a creature damages your hound with an attack: move up to half your Speed and make one melee Unarmed Strike or Pugilist weapon attack against that creature.

features.name: Off The Chain
features.description: Reaction when your hound becomes Bloodied from damage or takes damage while Bloodied: it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 5 times your Pugilist level and, for 1 minute, +15 feet of Speed and you can command its Bite with no Bonus Action. Once per Long Rest, or restore it by spending 3 Moxie Points (no action).

features.name: Black Magic
features.description: You learn two Warlock cantrips and choose one level 1 Warlock spell that is always prepared; you can cast that spell once per Long Rest without a slot or with any slots you have. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these. On gaining a level, you can swap one of these spells for another Warlock spell of the same level.

features.name: Dread Hand
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can transform a limb for 1 minute, once per Short or Long Rest. During it: Reaction to make an Unarmed Strike against a creature in reach that hit you with a melee attack; on an Unarmed Strike hit, roll damage dice twice and pick either result; and your first Unarmed Strike miss each turn can be rerolled (new roll must be used).

features.name: Deal with the Devil
features.description: Pick one option, changeable after a Long Rest: Cloak of Shadows (cast Invisibility without a slot once per Short or Long Rest), Mask of Many Faces (cast Disguise Self without a slot, at will), or Otherworldly Walk (cast Misty Step without a slot once per Short or Long Rest).

features.name: Grotesque Growth
features.description: When you use Dread Hand, you can also gain the Enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce and 10-foot reach. Once per Long Rest, or take 1 Exhaustion level (no action) to restore the use.

features.name: Fountain of Viscera
features.description: Magic action, 6 Moxie Points: a creature in reach makes a Dexterity save (DC 8 + your STR mod + PB), taking 100 Piercing damage on a failure or 50 on a success. If this drops it to 0 Hit Points it dies, and creatures you choose in a 30-foot Emanation must pass a Wisdom save (same DC) or be Frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of their turns. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Bad Attitude
features.description: Gain Intimidation proficiency if you lack it, and add your Strength modifier (minimum +1) to Intimidation checks.

features.name: Salty Salute
features.description: Bonus Action: a creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save or takes Psychic damage equal to your Fisticuffs die + your CON mod and has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn. This subclass's save DC is 8 + your CON mod + PB.

features.name: Dirty Tricks
features.description: One Dirty Trick per turn, each usable once per Short or Long Rest. Heelstomper: when your Unarmed Strike or Pugilist weapon deals damage, the target makes a Dexterity save or has Speed 0 for 1 minute (save repeats at end of each of its turns). Low Blow: on the same trigger, the target makes a Strength save or attacks against it have Advantage until the end of your next turn. Pocket Sand: Bonus Action, a creature within 10 feet makes a Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Mean Old Cuss
features.description: Bonus Action: up to a number of creatures equal to your Pugilist level within 30 feet that can see or hear you each make a Wisdom save or take Psychic damage equal to your Fisticuffs die + your CON mod and have Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it by spending 3 Moxie Points (no action).

features.name: Dirtier Tricks
features.description: Two more Dirty Tricks (same one-per-turn and once per Short or Long Rest limits). Rabbit Punch: on an Unarmed Strike or Pugilist weapon hit, until the end of your next turn the target loses any Psychic Resistance and has Disadvantage on saving throws. Sucker Punch: turn such a hit into a Critical Hit that rolls the damage dice three times instead of twice.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Use this subclass's Channel Divinity once per Short or Long Rest, choosing an effect. Fists of Faith: Bonus Action, for 1 minute your Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage (2d4 against Fiends and Undead). Grace of the Gods: Bonus Action, for 1 minute you have Resistance to Necrotic damage and can add 1d4 to your saving throws.

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.description: You have a healing pool of 3 times your Pugilist level Hit Points, refilled on a Long Rest. Bonus Action: touch a creature (or yourself) and restore any amount from the pool, or spend 5 points to end the Poisoned condition on it (those points heal nothing).

features.name: Ravaged But Resolute
features.description: When you use Bloodied But Unbowed, you can refill your Lay On Hands pool completely. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Aura of Resilience
features.description: When you use Dig Deep, you can project a 10-foot Emanation for 10 minutes granting allies inside Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; it shuts off while you are Incapacitated. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Hallowed Hands
features.description: Once on each of your turns when an Unarmed Strike or Pugilist weapon hits, spend Lay On Hands points (up to your Pugilist level) to deal that much extra Radiant damage, doubled against Fiends and Undead.

features.name: Groundwork
features.description: Compression Lock: if you start your turn grappling creatures, each takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Fisticuffs die + your STR mod (no action). Inescapable: spend 1 Moxie Point to impose Disadvantage on a save or check a creature makes against your grapple or shove DC. Stop and Drop: on an Unarmed Strike hit where you use no mastery property, you can apply both Grapple and Shove.

features.name: Muscle Mass
features.description: Choose Acrobatics or Athletics: gain proficiency in it, or Expertise if already proficient.

features.name: Meat Shield
features.description: While grappling a creature, you have Half Cover against attacks from creatures you aren't grappling. Reaction and 1 Moxie Point when such a creature misses you with an attack roll: it must reroll that attack against a creature you are grappling.

features.name: Heavyweight
features.description: You count as one size larger for Grapple and Shove, and moving a grappled creature of your size or smaller costs no extra movement.

features.name: Clean Finish
features.description: Reaction when a creature you are grappling ends its turn: it makes a Constitution save against your grapple escape DC or is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn. If it is Bloodied and already Incapacitated by this feature, it drops to 0 Hit Points instead; after reducing a creature to 0 this way, you can't use the feature again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Bare Knuckle Boxer
features.description: Your Unarmed Strike attack rolls score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

features.name: Cross Counter
features.description: Reaction and 1 Moxie Point when a melee attack damages you: reduce the damage by 1d10 + your STR mod + your Pugilist level. If it drops to 0, you can make an Unarmed Strike or Pugilist weapon attack against a creature in reach as part of that Reaction.

features.name: Combo Maker
features.description: When your Unarmed Strike damages a creature, you can forgo Heavy Hitter's Grapple or Shove to gain Advantage on your attack rolls against that target until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Combo Breaker
features.description: When Cross Counter reduces the damage to 0, regain 1 Moxie Point.

features.name: Knock Out
features.description: Coldcock: a creature you score a Critical Hit against makes a Constitution save (DC 8 + your STR mod + PB) or is Unconscious for 1 minute or until it takes damage. Uppercut: Reaction and 1 Moxie Point when an Unarmed Strike hits, making it a Critical Hit; once per Short or Long Rest.
